guide.summary: Chinese compares with word order, not with endings like '-er'. The frame is A 比 B + adjective, and the adjective stays bare: how much more goes AFTER it (高一点儿, 高得多, 高三厘米), never 很 before it. 'Less than' is A 没有 B + adjective, 'the same' is A 跟 B 一样, and 更, 最, 比较 and 越来越 are adverbs that sit right before the adjective.

subs.label: A 比 B + adjective (no 很)
subs.focus: The learner must build A 比 B + bare adjective and decide what may stand before the adjective: nothing, 更 or 还, but never 很, 非常, 太, 真, 有点儿 or 比较. Also the order: 比 B comes before the adjective, not after it as in English. Classic mistakes: 他比我很高; 他高比我.

subs.label: How much more: 一点儿, 得多, 多了, numbers
subs.focus: The learner must put the size of the difference after the adjective: 一点儿 / 一些 for a little, 得多 / 多了 for a lot, or number + measure (大两岁, 高三厘米, 贵五十块). Classic mistakes: 比他有点儿高, 比他很高 for 'much taller', and the amount before the adjective (比我两岁大).

subs.label: A 没有 B (那么) + adjective
subs.focus: The learner must say 'not as ... as' with A 没有 B (这么/那么) + adjective, not by negating the adjective inside a 比 sentence, and must keep the adjective free of amounts and degree words. Classic mistakes: 我比他不高; 我没有他高得多; 我没有他很高.

subs.label: 不比 and 不如
subs.focus: The learner must tell 不比 (not more than: maybe equal, usually contradicting someone) from 没有 and 不如 (clearly less), and build A 不如 B (+ positive adjective). Classic mistakes: 不比 used for 'less than'; a bad-quality adjective after 不如 (不如他差); 不如 combined with 比.

subs.label: A 跟/和 B 一样 (+ adjective), 不一样
subs.focus: The learner must express equality with A 跟/和 B 一样 (+ adjective) and difference with 不一样, choosing 跟/和 and not 比, and keeping 很 out of 一样 + adjective. Classic mistakes: 我比他一样高; 我跟他一样很高; 我一样高跟他.

subs.label: 最, 更 and 比较 as adverbs
subs.focus: The learner must choose 最 (top of a group), 更 (even more) or 比较 (fairly; no B named) and place it right before the adjective or 喜欢. Classic mistakes: 比较 as 'than' (这个比较那个贵); 比较 inside a 比 sentence (他比我比较高); English order with 最 (他是最高在我们班).

subs.label: 比 with verb + 得 + adjective
subs.focus: The learner must compare how an action is done: 他比我跑得快 or 他跑得比我快, keeping 得 and, when there is an object, repeating the verb or fronting the object (他说汉语说得比我好). Classic mistakes: dropping 得 (他比我跑快); 比我 after the adjective (他跑得快比我); object between verb and 得 (他说汉语得比我好).

subs.label: 越来越 + adjective
subs.focus: The learner must put 越来越 after the subject and directly before an adjective or a verb of feeling, with no other degree word, and with an action verb must attach it to the complement (跑得越来越快). Classic mistakes: 越来越很冷; 越来越更好; 越来越天气冷; 他越来越跑得快 or 他越来越跑快.

rules.rule: To say A is more ... than B, put 比 B between A and the adjective. The adjective is bare: no 很, 非常, 太 or 真 in front of it.

examples.py: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng
examples.en: Today is colder than yesterday.

examples.py: wǒ gē ge bǐ wǒ gāo
examples.en: My older brother is taller than me.

examples.py: zhè jiàn yī fu bǐ nà jiàn guì
examples.en: This piece of clothing is more expensive than that one.

rules.note: The repeated noun in B is usually dropped: 那件, 你的, 昨天的.

rules.rule: The only degree adverbs allowed before the adjective in a 比 sentence are 更 and 还. Both mean 'even more' and imply that B is already quite tall, cold, expensive and so on.
rules.pattern: A + 比 + B + 更 / 还 + Adjective

examples.zh: 他很高，他弟弟比他更高。
examples.py: tā hěn gāo tā dì di bǐ tā gèng gāo
examples.en: He is tall, and his younger brother is even taller than him.

examples.py: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān hái lěng
examples.en: Today is even colder than yesterday.

examples.zh: 上海的夏天比北京更热。
examples.py: shàng hǎi de xià tiān bǐ běi jīng gèng rè
examples.en: Summer in Shanghai is even hotter than in Beijing.

rules.rule: A little more or a lot more is said after the adjective: 一点儿 or 一些 for a small difference, 得多 or 多了 for a big one.
rules.pattern: A + 比 + B + Adjective + 一点儿 / 一些 / 得多 / 多了

examples.zh: 这个比那个便宜一点儿。
examples.py: zhè ge bǐ nà ge pián yi yī diǎn r
examples.en: This one is a bit cheaper than that one.

examples.zh: 坐地铁比坐公共汽车快得多。
examples.py: zuò dì tiě bǐ zuò gōng gòng qì chē kuài de duō
examples.en: Taking the subway is much faster than taking the bus.

examples.py: tā de hàn yǔ bǐ wǒ hǎo duō le
examples.en: His Chinese is much better than mine.

rules.note: 有点儿 goes before an adjective and cannot be used in a 比 sentence; use 一点儿 after the adjective. 得多 and 多了 are interchangeable here. In speech 很多 after the adjective (贵很多) is also heard; 很 before the adjective is never possible.

rules.rule: An exact difference is number + measure word, and it also goes after the adjective. For ages use 大 and 小.
rules.pattern: A + 比 + B + Adjective + number + measure

examples.py: wǒ jiě jie bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì
examples.en: My older sister is two years older than me.

examples.py: tā bǐ wǒ gāo sān lí mǐ
examples.en: He is three centimetres taller than me.

examples.py: zhè jiàn bǐ nà jiàn guì wǔ shí kuài
examples.en: This one is fifty yuan more expensive than that one.

rules.rule: 'A is not as ... as B' is A 没有 B + adjective, often with 这么 or 那么 before the adjective. Do not negate the adjective in a 比 sentence, and do not add amounts or 得多 after the adjective.
rules.pattern: A + 没有 + B + (这么 / 那么) + Adjective

examples.py: wǒ méi yǒu tā gāo
examples.en: I'm not as tall as he is.

examples.py: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me lěng
examples.en: Today is not as cold as yesterday.

examples.py: zuò huǒ chē méi yǒu zuò fēi jī kuài
examples.en: Taking the train is not as fast as flying.

rules.note: The adjective is normally the 'big' end of the scale (高, 大, 快, 贵, 好). 没 alone (我没他高) is common in speech.

rules.rule: A 不比 B + adjective means 'A is not more ... than B': they may be about the same. It is mostly used to disagree with what someone said or expects. For a plain 'less than', use 没有.

examples.zh: 他不比我高，我们差不多。
examples.py: tā bù bǐ wǒ gāo wǒ men chà bu duō
examples.en: He's no taller than me; we're about the same.

examples.zh: 这家店的东西不比那家便宜。
examples.py: zhè jiā diàn de dōng xi bù bǐ nà jiā pián yi
examples.en: Things in this shop are no cheaper than in that one.

rules.note: 不 goes before 比, never before the adjective: 比我不高 is wrong.

rules.rule: A 不如 B means 'A is not as good as B'. An adjective can be added to say in what way, and it must name a good or 'big' quality. 不如 replaces 比; the two are not combined.

examples.py: wǒ de hàn yǔ bù rú tā
examples.en: My Chinese is not as good as his.

examples.zh: 这个手机不如那个好用。
examples.py: zhè ge shǒu jī bù rú nà ge hǎo yòng
examples.en: This phone is not as easy to use as that one.

examples.py: zǒu lù bù rú qí zì xíng chē kuài
examples.en: Walking is not as fast as riding a bike.

rules.note: 不如 is a little more formal than 没有. Without an adjective, 没有 cannot replace it: 我的汉语没有他 is incomplete.

rules.rule: 'The same as' is A 跟 B 一样 or A 和 B 一样, and an adjective can follow 一样 with no 很. 'Different' is 不一样. 比 is never used with 一样.
rules.pattern: A + 跟 / 和 + B + 一样 / 不一样 + (Adjective)

examples.py: wǒ gēn tā yī yàng gāo
examples.en: I'm as tall as he is.

examples.py: wǒ de shǒu jī hé nǐ de yī yàng
examples.en: My phone is the same as yours.

examples.zh: 这两个字的意思不一样。
examples.py: zhè liǎng ge zì de yì si bù yī yàng
examples.en: The meanings of these two characters are different.

examples.zh: 这里的冬天跟北京一样冷。
examples.py: zhè lǐ de dōng tiān gēn běi jīng yī yàng lěng
examples.en: Winter here is as cold as in Beijing.

rules.note: 不一样 usually stands alone, without an adjective. To say 'not as tall as', use 没有 (我没有他高) rather than 跟他不一样高.

rules.rule: 最 marks the top of a group of three or more; 更 means 'even more' than something just mentioned. Both go directly before the adjective or a verb such as 喜欢. The group goes before 最, not after it.
rules.pattern: (Group) + 最 / 更 + Adjective / 喜欢 ...

examples.py: tā shì wǒ men bān zuì gāo de
examples.en: He is the tallest in our class.

examples.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan chūn tiān
examples.en: I like spring best.

examples.py: zhè ge bù cuò nà ge gèng hǎo
examples.en: This one is good; that one is even better.

rules.rule: 比较 before an adjective is an adverb meaning 'fairly, rather'. No B is named. It is not the 比 of comparison and cannot be put into a 比 sentence.
rules.pattern: Subject + 比较 + Adjective / 喜欢 ...

examples.py: jīn tiān bǐ jiào lěng
examples.en: It's fairly cold today.

examples.py: zhè ge wèn tí bǐ jiào nán
examples.en: This question is rather difficult.

examples.py: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan hē chá
examples.en: I prefer drinking tea.

rules.rule: To compare how an action is done, keep verb + 得 + adjective and put 比 B either before the verb or right after 得. With an object, repeat the verb or put the object first.
rules.pattern: A + 比 + B + Verb + 得 + Adjective  /  A + Verb + 得 + 比 + B + Adjective

examples.py: tā bǐ wǒ pǎo de kuài
examples.en: He runs faster than me.

examples.py: tā pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài
examples.en: He runs faster than me.

examples.py: mèi mei chàng gē chàng de bǐ wǒ hǎo
examples.en: My younger sister sings better than I do.

examples.py: wǒ jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān qǐ de zǎo
examples.en: I got up earlier today than yesterday.

rules.note: Both positions of 比 B are correct and mean the same. Amounts still go at the very end: 他跑得比我快得多. The negative uses 没有 in the same slots: 我跑得没有他快.

rules.rule: 'More and more' is 越来越 right before an adjective or a verb of feeling, after the subject, usually with 了 at the end. No 很 or 更 with it. With an action verb, 越来越 goes after 得.
rules.pattern: Subject + 越来越 + Adjective + (了)  /  Subject + Verb + 得 + 越来越 + Adjective

examples.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le
examples.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.

examples.zh: 我越来越喜欢这个城市了。
examples.py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan zhè ge chéng shì le
examples.en: I like this city more and more.

examples.zh: 他汉语说得越来越好了。
examples.py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
examples.en: He speaks Chinese better and better.

right.py: tā bǐ wǒ gāo de duō
right.en: He is much taller than me.

contrasts.why: 很 cannot stand before the adjective in a 比 sentence. 'Much' is said after the adjective with 得多 or 多了.

right.py: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng yī diǎn r
right.en: Today is a bit colder than yesterday.

contrasts.why: 有点儿 goes before an adjective and does not fit a 比 sentence. The amount of difference is 一点儿, after the adjective.

right.py: wǒ bǐ jiě jie xiǎo liǎng suì
right.en: I'm two years younger than my older sister.

contrasts.why: English says 'two years younger'; Chinese puts the number after the adjective.

right.en: I'm not as tall as he is.

contrasts.why: A 比 sentence is not negated at the adjective. 'Not as tall as' is A 没有 B 高.

right.py: wǒ méi yǒu tā nà me gāo
right.en: I'm not as tall as he is.

contrasts.why: After 没有 the adjective takes no amount or degree complement; only 这么 or 那么 may come before it.

right.py: wǒ gēn tā yī yàng gāo
right.en: I'm as tall as he is.

contrasts.why: 比 always means a difference. Sameness uses 跟 or 和 with 一样.

right.py: tā bǐ wǒ pǎo de kuài

contrasts.why: Describing how an action is done needs 得 between the verb and the adjective, in a comparison too.

right.py: zhè ge bǐ nà ge guì
right.en: This one is more expensive than that one.

contrasts.why: 比较 before an adjective means 'fairly' and takes no B. 'Than' is 比 alone.

right.py: tā shì wǒ men bān zuì gāo de
right.en: He is the tallest in our class.

contrasts.why: The group goes before 最, not after it as in English 'tallest in our class'.

right.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le
right.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.

contrasts.why: 越来越 already gives the degree, so 很, 更 and 非常 cannot be added. 了 at the end marks the change.

cheat: 比 in the sentence? Adjective bare: no 很, 非常, 太, 有点儿. Only 更 or 还 may stand before it.
How much more goes AFTER the adjective: 高一点儿, 高得多, 高多了, 高三厘米, 大两岁.
'Not as ... as' = A 没有 B (那么) + adjective. Never 比 ... 不 + adjective.
不比 = 'no more than' (maybe equal); 不如 = 'not as good as', only with a positive adjective.
Same = 跟 / 和 ... 一样 (+ adjective), different = 不一样. No 比, no 很.
Action compared? Keep 得: 比我跑得快 or 跑得比我快.
越来越 and 比较 sit right before the adjective, alone: no 很, no 更, no B.

items.q: 我的桌子比你的___大。
items.zh: 我的桌子比你的大。
items.py: wǒ de zhuō zi bǐ nǐ de dà
items.en: My desk is bigger than yours.
items.why: After 比 B the adjective stands bare, so 大 takes nothing in front of it. 很 and 太 are degree words that clash with the comparison.

items.q: 今天经理比昨天___忙，连午饭都没吃。
items.zh: 今天经理比昨天更忙，连午饭都没吃。
items.py: jīn tiān jīng lǐ bǐ zuó tiān gèng máng lián wǔ fàn dōu méi chī
items.en: The manager is even busier today than yesterday; he didn't even have lunch.
items.why: Only 更 (or 还) may stand before the adjective in a 比 sentence, and here it says 'even busier'. 很, 非常 and 比较 cannot appear in 比 sentences.

items.q: 这家医院比那家___远。
items.zh: 这家医院比那家远。
items.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn bǐ nà jiā yuǎn
items.en: This hospital is farther away than that one.
items.why: A plain 比 comparison keeps the adjective bare. 太 and 非常 cannot go before 远 once 比 is in the sentence.

items.q: 这个月的工作比上个月___多，大家每天都要加班。
items.zh: 这个月的工作比上个月多，大家每天都要加班。
items.py: zhè ge yuè de gōng zuò bǐ shàng ge yuè duō dà jiā měi tiān dōu yào jiā bān
items.en: This month's workload is bigger than last month's, so everyone has to work overtime every day.
items.why: With 比, 多 stays bare. 很 and 非常 do not combine with 比; 'a lot more' would go after the adjective instead.

items.q: 这个药比那个药贵___。
items.zh: 这个药比那个药贵一点儿。
items.py: zhè ge yào bǐ nà ge yào guì yī diǎn r
items.en: This medicine is a bit more expensive than that one.
items.why: A small difference goes after the adjective: 贵一点儿. 有点儿 goes before an adjective, and 很 can never follow one.

items.q: 坐地铁去公司比开车快___，不用堵车。
items.zh: 坐地铁去公司比开车快得多，不用堵车。
items.py: zuò dì tiě qù gōng sī bǐ kāi chē kuài de duō bù yòng dǔ chē
items.en: Taking the subway to the office is much faster than driving; there's no traffic jam.
items.why: 'Much' after the adjective is 得多. 很, 有点儿 and 非常 all belong before an adjective and cannot follow 快.

items.q: 他今天的咳嗽比昨天好___。
items.zh: 他今天的咳嗽比昨天好多了。
items.py: tā jīn tiān de ké sou bǐ zuó tiān hǎo duō le
items.en: His cough is much better today than yesterday.
items.why: 好多了 is the set way to say 'much better' in a 比 sentence. 很, 非常 and 太 cannot be attached to 好 here.

items.q: 我的血压比去年低___，医生说不用吃药了。
items.zh: 我的血压比去年低一些，医生说不用吃药了。
items.py: wǒ de xuè yā bǐ qù nián dī yī xiē yī shēng shuō bù yòng chī yào le
items.en: My blood pressure is a little lower than last year; the doctor says I no longer need medicine.
items.why: A small difference follows the adjective: 低一些. 有点儿 and 非常 stand before an adjective and do not work in a 比 sentence.

items.q: 新来的同事比我___三岁，可是工作经验比我多。
items.zh: 新来的同事比我小三岁，可是工作经验比我多。
items.py: xīn lái de tóng shì bǐ wǒ xiǎo sān suì kě shì gōng zuò jīng yàn bǐ wǒ duō
items.en: The new colleague is three years younger than me, but he has more work experience.
items.why: The number goes right after a bare adjective: 小三岁. 很小 puts a degree word in front, and 小得 would need a complement of its own.

items.q: 这家公司的工资比我们公司高___，所以不少人想去那儿工作。
items.zh: 这家公司的工资比我们公司高得多，所以不少人想去那儿工作。
items.py: zhè jiā gōng sī de gōng zī bǐ wǒ men gōng sī gāo de duō suǒ yǐ bù shǎo rén xiǎng qù nà r gōng zuò
items.en: This company's pay is much higher than ours, so quite a few people want to work there.
items.why: The size of a big difference follows the adjective: 高得多. 很 and 有点儿 cannot come after 高.

items.q: 病人今天没有昨天___难受。
items.zh: 病人今天没有昨天那么难受。
items.py: bìng rén jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me nán shòu
items.en: The patient isn't as uncomfortable today as yesterday.
items.why: 'Not as ... as' is 没有 B (那么) + adjective. 很 and 比 cannot be added after 没有 B.

items.q: 我的工作没有你的___累。
items.zh: 我的工作没有你的累。
items.py: wǒ de gōng zuò méi yǒu nǐ de lèi
items.en: My job isn't as tiring as yours.
items.why: After 没有 B the adjective is bare (or has 这么/那么). 很 or 比 cannot be inserted before 累.

items.q: 这个办公室___那个办公室大，只有那个的一半，我们得搬走。
items.zh: 这个办公室没有那个办公室大，只有那个的一半，我们得搬走。
items.py: zhè ge bàn gōng shì méi yǒu nà ge bàn gōng shì dà zhǐ yǒu nà ge de yī bàn wǒ men děi bān zǒu
items.en: This office is not as big as that one, only half the size, so we have to move.
items.why: 'Clearly smaller' is 没有 B + adjective. 不比 would only say 'not bigger', which is not the point when it is half the size. 比不 is not a pattern.

items.q: 坐公共汽车去医院没有坐地铁___，所以我每次都坐地铁。
items.zh: 坐公共汽车去医院没有坐地铁快，所以我每次都坐地铁。
items.py: zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù yī yuàn méi yǒu zuò dì tiě kuài suǒ yǐ wǒ měi cì dōu zuò dì tiě
items.en: Taking the bus to the hospital isn't as fast as taking the subway, so I always take the subway.
items.why: After 没有 B the adjective stays bare. An amount like 得多 or a degree word like 很 cannot follow it.

items.q: 你说他比我高？他___我高，我们一样高。
items.zh: 你说他比我高？他不比我高，我们一样高。
items.py: nǐ shuō tā bǐ wǒ gāo tā bù bǐ wǒ gāo wǒ men yī yàng gāo
items.en: You say he's taller than me? He's no taller than me; we're the same height.
items.why: 不比 means 'not more than', so equal height is possible. 没有 and 不如 say he is clearly shorter, which contradicts 一样高.

items.q: 我的英语___小王，他在美国住过五年。
items.zh: 我的英语不如小王，他在美国住过五年。
items.py: wǒ de yīng yǔ bù rú xiǎo wáng tā zài měi guó zhù guò wǔ nián
items.en: My English is not as good as Xiao Wang's; he lived in America for five years.
items.why: 不如 B can stand alone to mean 'not as good as B'. 不比 needs an adjective and means something else, and 比不 is not a pattern.

items.q: 坐班车___自己开车方便，所以他还是每天开车上班。
items.zh: 坐班车不如自己开车方便，所以他还是每天开车上班。
items.py: zuò bān chē bù rú zì jǐ kāi chē fāng biàn suǒ yǐ tā hái shì měi tiān kāi chē shàng bān
items.en: Taking the shuttle bus is not as convenient as driving yourself, so he still drives to work every day.
items.why: 不如 B + a good quality (方便) means 'not as ... as B'. 不是 and 不太 cannot take a 'than' phrase.

items.q: 我的手机___你的一样。
items.zh: 我的手机跟你的一样。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī gēn nǐ de yī yàng
items.en: My phone is the same as yours.
items.why: Sameness is 跟 (or 和) ... 一样. 比 and 没有 mark a difference, which contradicts 一样.

items.q: 小王和我___高。
items.zh: 小王和我一样高。
items.py: xiǎo wáng hé wǒ yī yàng gāo
items.en: Xiao Wang and I are equally tall.
items.why: 和 ... 一样 + adjective says two things are equal. 一点儿 and 一些 only describe a small amount.

items.q: 我们公司的上班时间跟他们公司___，他们九点，我们八点半。
items.zh: 我们公司的上班时间跟他们公司不一样，他们九点，我们八点半。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī de shàng bān shí jiān gēn tā men gōng sī bù yí yàng tā men jiǔ diǎn wǒ men bā diǎn bàn
items.en: Our working hours are different from theirs: they start at nine, we start at half past eight.
items.why: 'Different' is 跟 B 不一样. 没有 and 不比 are for comparing degree with an adjective and do not fit here.

items.q: 今天医院的病人跟昨天一样___，一直排到门口。
items.zh: 今天医院的病人跟昨天一样多，一直排到门口。
items.py: jīn tiān yī yuàn de bìng rén gēn zuó tiān yī yàng duō yì zhí pái dào mén kǒu
items.en: There are just as many patients at the hospital today as yesterday; the line reaches the door.
items.why: After 一样 the adjective is bare: 一样多. 很 and 更 cannot be added, and 更 would also change the meaning.

items.q: 我们办公室七个人里，小李___忙。
items.zh: 我们办公室七个人里，小李最忙。
items.py: wǒ men bàn gōng shì qī ge rén lǐ xiǎo lǐ zuì máng
items.en: Of the seven people in our office, Xiao Li is the busiest.
items.why: 最 picks the top of a group of three or more. 更 needs one thing to be compared with, and 比较 only means 'fairly'.

items.q: 这个药很苦，那个药___苦。
items.zh: 这个药很苦，那个药更苦。
items.py: zhè ge yào hěn kǔ nà ge yào gèng kǔ
items.en: This medicine is bitter and that one is even more bitter.
items.why: 更 means 'even more' than something just mentioned. 最 needs a group of three or more, and 比较 would only say 'fairly bitter'.

items.q: 这家公司的工资___高，不过不是最高的，工作也很累。
items.zh: 这家公司的工资比较高，不过不是最高的，工作也很累。
items.py: zhè jiā gōng sī de gōng zī bǐ jiào gāo bù guò bú shì zuì gāo de gōng zuò yě hěn lèi
items.en: The pay at this company is fairly high, though not the highest, and the work is tiring.
items.why: 比较 means 'fairly' with no B named. 不是最高的 rules out 最 here, and 更 would need something to compare with.

items.q: 在我们公司，经理___早到，每个人都比他晚。
items.zh: 在我们公司，经理最早到，每个人都比他晚。
items.py: zài wǒ men gōng sī jīng lǐ zuì zǎo dào měi ge rén dōu bǐ tā wǎn
items.en: In our company the manager arrives earliest; everyone is later than him.
items.why: 'Everyone is later' makes him the top of the group, so 最. 更 needs a single comparison and 比较 would only be 'fairly early'.

items.q: 这件事是我们办公室里___重要的。
items.zh: 这件事是我们办公室里最重要的。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì shì wǒ men bàn gōng shì lǐ zuì zhòng yào de
items.en: This is the most important matter in our office.
items.why: The group goes first and 最 stands right before 重要: 最重要的. 很 and 比较 would not give 'the most'.

items.q: 小王比我打字打___快。
items.zh: 小王比我打字打得快。
items.py: xiǎo wáng bǐ wǒ dǎ zì dǎ de kuài
items.en: Xiao Wang types faster than me.
items.why: An action compared by manner needs verb + 得 + adjective. 的 and 地 are different particles and cannot link a verb to its complement.

items.q: 他今天起___比我早，七点就到公司了。
items.zh: 他今天起得比我早，七点就到公司了。
items.py: tā jīn tiān qǐ de bǐ wǒ zǎo qī diǎn jiù dào gōng sī le
items.en: He got up earlier than me today; he was at the company by seven.
items.why: 起得比我早 keeps 得 between the verb and the comparison. 起了 would just say he got up.

items.q: 他说汉语说得___我好。
items.zh: 他说汉语说得比我好。
items.py: tā shuō hàn yǔ shuō de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.en: He speaks Chinese better than I do.
items.why: 比 + the person compared sits right after 得. 跟 would mean 'the same as', and 更 has no 'than' phrase.

items.q: 弟弟睡___比我多，每天睡十个小时。
items.zh: 弟弟睡得比我多，每天睡十个小时。
items.py: dì di shuì de bǐ wǒ duō měi tiān shuì shí ge xiǎo shí
items.en: My younger brother sleeps more than I do, ten hours a day.
items.why: Verb + 得 + 比我 + adjective compares how much he sleeps. 的 and 地 cannot take the place of 得 here.

items.q: 奶奶的身体___好了，每天都能散步。
items.zh: 奶奶的身体越来越好了，每天都能散步。
items.py: nǎi nǎi de shēn tǐ yuè lái yuè hǎo le měi tiān dōu néng sàn bù
items.en: Grandma's health is getting better and better; she can take a walk every day.
items.why: 'More and more' is the fixed 越来越 before the adjective. 越 alone needs a second 越, and 不太 says the opposite of the cue.

items.q: 他每天跑步，跑得___快了。
items.zh: 他每天跑步，跑得越来越快了。
items.py: tā měi tiān pǎo bù pǎo de yuè lái yuè kuài le
items.en: He runs every day and runs faster and faster.
items.why: With an action verb 越来越 goes after 得, right before the adjective. 越来 is incomplete and 不太 says the opposite.

items.q: 天气越来越冷，医院里感冒的病人也___多了。
items.zh: 天气越来越冷，医院里感冒的病人也越来越多了。
items.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng yī yuàn lǐ gǎn mào de bìng rén yě yuè lái yuè duō le
items.en: The weather is getting colder, and there are more and more patients with colds at the hospital.
items.why: 越来越 is a fixed three-syllable pattern. 越来 and 越是 are not ways to say 'more and more'.

items.q: 听说这个城市的空气___差，很多人都生病了。
items.zh: 听说这个城市的空气越来越差，很多人都生病了。
items.py: tīng shuō zhè ge chéng shì de kōng qì yuè lái yuè chà hěn duō rén dōu shēng bìng le
items.en: I hear the air in this city is getting worse and worse and many people have fallen ill.
items.why: 越来越 already supplies the degree, so 很 cannot follow it. 更 needs something to compare with and does not show gradual change.

items.q: 他的汉语说得___好，同事们都夸他。
items.zh: 他的汉语说得越来越好，同事们都夸他。
items.py: tā de hàn yǔ shuō de yuè lái yuè hǎo tóng shì men dōu kuā tā
items.en: His Chinese is getting better and better, and his colleagues all praise him.
items.why: After 得 the pattern is 越来越 + adjective. 越 and 越来 alone are incomplete.

items.zh: 今天的工作比昨天的多。
items.py: jīn tiān de gōng zuò bǐ zuó tiān de duō
items.en: Today's work is more than yesterday's.
items.why: 比 B goes between A and the bare adjective. 多 cannot come before 比 and no 很 is needed.

items.zh: 我的感冒比你的更重。
items.py: wǒ de gǎn mào bǐ nǐ de gèng zhòng
items.en: My cold is even worse than yours.
items.why: 更 sits right before the adjective and after 比 B. Putting 更 before 比 breaks the pattern.

items.zh: 他们部门的电脑比我们部门的还旧。
items.py: tā men bù mén de diàn nǎo bǐ wǒ men bù mén de hái jiù
items.en: The computers in their department are even older than the ones in ours.
items.why: 还 goes after 比 B and right before the adjective, meaning 'even older'. 旧 cannot come before 比.

items.zh: 医院比公司远。
items.py: yī yuàn bǐ gōng sī yuǎn
items.en: The hospital is farther away than the company.
items.why: A 比 B + adjective: the thing compared with comes between 比 and 远. English 'farther than' order does not carry over.

items.zh: 我比小王大一岁。
items.py: wǒ bǐ xiǎo wáng dà yī suì
items.en: I'm one year older than Xiao Wang.
items.why: The amount of the difference goes after the adjective: 大一岁. 一岁大 before the adjective is wrong.

items.zh: 这瓶药比那瓶贵十块。
items.py: zhè píng yào bǐ nà píng guì shí kuài
items.en: This bottle of medicine is ten yuan more expensive than that one.
items.why: Number + measure follows the adjective in a 比 sentence: 贵十块. Placing 十块 before 贵 is the English order.

items.zh: 做手术比吃药贵得多。
items.py: zuò shǒu shù bǐ chī yào guì de duō
items.en: Having an operation is much more expensive than taking medicine.
items.why: 'Much' is 得多 after the adjective. 很 cannot stand before 贵 in a 比 sentence.

items.zh: 这次体检的血压比上次低一些。
items.py: zhè cì tǐ jiǎn de xuè yā bǐ shàng cì dī yī xiē
items.en: The blood pressure at this check-up is a little lower than last time.
items.why: A small difference, 一些, comes after the adjective 低. 有点儿 before 低 would break the 比 pattern.

items.zh: 我没有经理忙。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu jīng lǐ máng
items.en: I'm not as busy as the manager.
items.why: 'Not as ... as' is A 没有 B + adjective. The adjective is not negated and 比 is not used.

items.zh: 坐地铁没有打车那么方便。
items.py: zuò dì tiě méi yǒu dǎ chē nà me fāng biàn
items.en: Taking the subway is not as convenient as taking a taxi.
items.why: 没有 B 那么 + adjective is the 'not as ... as' frame; 那么 goes right before the adjective.

items.zh: 他的病不比我的轻。
items.py: tā de bìng bù bǐ wǒ de qīng
items.en: His illness is no milder than mine.
items.why: 不 goes before 比, not before the adjective: 不比 B + adjective. 比我的不轻 is wrong.

items.zh: 我的汉语不如你。
items.py: wǒ de hàn yǔ bù rú nǐ
items.en: My Chinese is not as good as yours.
items.why: A 不如 B says A is not as good as B, with no 比 and no adjective needed.

items.zh: 我跟他一样高。
items.py: wǒ gēn tā yī yàng gāo
items.en: I'm as tall as he is.
items.why: 跟 B 一样 + adjective is the frame for 'as ... as'. 比 is never used with 一样.

items.zh: 我的工资和你的不一样。
items.py: wǒ de gōng zī hé nǐ de bù yí yàng
items.en: My salary is not the same as yours.
items.why: 和 B 不一样 says the two things differ. 一样 and the negative 不 stay together after B.

items.zh: 这家医院的服务跟那家一样好。
items.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn de fú wù gēn nà jiā yī yàng hǎo
items.en: This hospital's service is as good as that one's.
items.why: 跟 那家 一样 好: the adjective follows 一样 directly, with no 很 in between.

items.zh: 我最喜欢星期五。
items.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan xīng qī wǔ
items.en: I like Friday best.
items.why: 最 goes before the verb 喜欢 and after the subject, not at the end of the sentence.

items.zh: 他是我们部门最年轻的。
items.py: tā shì wǒ men bù mén zuì nián qīng de
items.en: He is the youngest in our department.
items.why: The group 我们部门 goes before 最, and 最 stands right before 年轻的. English 'youngest in the department' order fails.

items.zh: 我们部门这个月比较忙。
items.py: wǒ men bù mén zhè ge yuè bǐ jiào máng
items.en: Our department is fairly busy this month.
items.why: 比较 is an adverb directly before 忙, with no B named. It cannot be placed at the start or after the adjective.

items.zh: 他比我写得快。
items.py: tā bǐ wǒ xiě de kuài
items.en: He writes faster than me.
items.why: Both 他比我写得快 and 他写得比我快 are fine, but 得 must stay on the verb and the adjective comes last.

items.zh: 妹妹比我睡得晚多了。
items.py: mèi mei bǐ wǒ shuì de wǎn duō le
items.en: My younger sister goes to sleep much later than I do.
items.why: 比我 goes before 睡得 or right after it. The amount 多了 closes the sentence after the adjective.

items.zh: 妹妹唱歌唱得比我好。
items.py: mèi mei chàng gē chàng de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.en: My younger sister sings better than I do.
items.why: With an object the verb is repeated: 唱歌唱得 ... 比我 can also sit before the second 唱得 or before 唱歌. 歌 cannot stand between 唱 and 得.

items.zh: 今天我比昨天起得早。
items.py: jīn tiān wǒ bǐ zuó tiān qǐ de zǎo
items.en: I got up earlier today than yesterday.
items.why: Verb + 得 + adjective compares the manner of the action. 比昨天 can sit before 起得 or right after it, and the time word can come before or after 我; the adjective 早 goes last.

items.zh: 天气越来越冷了。
items.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le
items.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.
items.why: 越来越 goes right before the adjective and 了 closes the sentence to mark the change.

items.zh: 医院里的人越来越多了。
items.py: yī yuàn lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
items.en: There are more and more people in the hospital.
items.why: The subject comes first, then 越来越 immediately before 多, then 了.

items.zh: 小李跑步跑得越来越慢了。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ pǎo bù pǎo de yuè lái yuè màn le
items.en: Xiao Li is running slower and slower.
items.why: With an action verb 越来越 goes after 得: 跑得越来越慢. 越来越 cannot be put before 跑步.

items.src: 你的桌子大，我的桌子小。
items.src_py: nǐ de zhuō zi dà wǒ de zhuō zi xiǎo
items.task: Combine into one sentence with 比, starting with 你的桌子.
items.zh: 你的桌子比我的大。
items.py: nǐ de zhuō zi bǐ wǒ de dà
items.en: Your desk is bigger than mine.
items.why: The two clauses merge into A 比 B + adjective, with the bare adjective at the end.

items.src: 小李的感冒很重，我的感冒更重。
items.src_py: xiǎo lǐ de gǎn mào hěn zhòng wǒ de gǎn mào gèng zhòng
items.task: Combine into one sentence with 比 and 更, starting with 我的感冒.
items.zh: 我的感冒比小李的更重。
items.py: wǒ de gǎn mào bǐ xiǎo lǐ de gèng zhòng
items.en: My cold is even worse than Xiao Li's.
items.why: 更 is the degree word allowed in a 比 sentence. 很 would not be possible there.

items.src: 我今年三十岁，小王今年二十八岁。
items.src_py: wǒ jīn nián sān shí suì xiǎo wáng jīn nián èr shí bā suì
items.task: Say how much older I am than Xiao Wang, using 比.
items.zh: 我比小王大两岁。
items.py: wǒ bǐ xiǎo wáng dà liǎng suì
items.en: I'm two years older than Xiao Wang.
items.why: The two-year gap goes after 大 in a 比 sentence.

items.src: 这种药十块，那种药八块。
items.src_py: zhè zhǒng yào shí kuài nà zhǒng yào bā kuài
items.task: Say this one is two yuan more expensive, using 比.
items.zh: 这种药比那种贵两块。
items.py: zhè zhǒng yào bǐ nà zhǒng guì liǎng kuài
items.en: This medicine is two yuan more expensive than that kind.
items.why: The exact difference 两块 follows the adjective 贵.

items.src: 昨天的会开了一个小时，今天的会开了三个小时。
items.src_py: zuó tiān de huì kāi le yí ge xiǎo shí jīn tiān de huì kāi le sān ge xiǎo shí
items.task: Say today's meeting is two hours longer, using 比 (start with 今天的会).
items.zh: 今天的会比昨天的长两个小时。
items.py: jīn tiān de huì bǐ zuó tiān de cháng liǎng ge xiǎo shí
items.en: Today's meeting is two hours longer than yesterday's.
items.why: Amount of difference after the adjective: 长两个小时. It cannot come before 长.

items.src: 他很忙，我不太忙。
items.src_py: tā hěn máng wǒ bù tài máng
items.task: Say I'm not as busy as he is, using 没有.
items.zh: 我没有他忙。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu tā máng
items.en: I'm not as busy as he is.
items.why: 没有 B + adjective says 'not as ... as'. 比 plus a negated adjective would be wrong.

items.src: 我比小王累。
items.src_py: wǒ bǐ xiǎo wáng lèi
items.task: Reverse it: say Xiao Wang is not as tired as I am, using 没有.
items.zh: 小王没有我累。
items.py: xiǎo wáng méi yǒu wǒ lèi
items.en: Xiao Wang isn't as tired as I am.
items.why: Swap the two people and use 没有: A 没有 B + adjective.

items.src: 昨天比今天冷。
items.src_py: zuó tiān bǐ jīn tiān lěng
items.task: Say today is not as cold as yesterday, using 没有 and 那么.
items.zh: 今天没有昨天那么冷。
items.py: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me lěng
items.en: Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
items.why: 没有 B 那么 + adjective is the negative of 比. 那么 stands right before the adjective.

items.src: 他比我高。
items.src_py: tā bǐ wǒ gāo
items.task: Disagree: say he is no taller than me, using 不比.
items.zh: 他不比我高。
items.py: tā bù bǐ wǒ gāo
items.en: He's no taller than me.
items.why: 不比 is the negative of 比. It says he is not taller, and the two may be the same.

items.src: 那个办法比这个办法好。
items.src_py: nà ge bàn fǎ bǐ zhè ge bàn fǎ hǎo
items.task: Say this one is not as good as that one, using 不如.
items.zh: 这个办法不如那个办法好。
items.py: zhè ge bàn fǎ bù rú nà ge bàn fǎ hǎo
items.en: This method is not as good as that one.
items.why: 不如 B + a positive adjective says A falls short of B. 不如 is not combined with 比.

items.src: 我二十五岁，小李也二十五岁。
items.src_py: wǒ èr shí wǔ suì xiǎo lǐ yě èr shí wǔ suì
items.task: Say we are the same age, using 跟 and 一样 (use 大).
items.zh: 我跟小李一样大。
items.py: wǒ gēn xiǎo lǐ yī yàng dà
items.en: I'm the same age as Xiao Li.
items.why: 跟 B 一样 + adjective expresses equality. 大 here means age.

items.src: 你的工作很忙，我的工作也很忙。
items.src_py: nǐ de gōng zuò hěn máng wǒ de gōng zuò yě hěn máng
items.task: Say yours is just as busy as mine, using 和 and 一样, starting with 你的工作.
items.zh: 你的工作和我的一样忙。
items.py: nǐ de gōng zuò hé wǒ de yī yàng máng
items.en: Your job is just as busy as mine.
items.why: 和 B 一样 + adjective. 很 is dropped because 一样 already says 'equally'.

items.src: 我们部门的人都没有小王高。
items.src_py: wǒ men bù mén de rén dōu méi yǒu xiǎo wáng gāo
items.task: Say Xiao Wang is the tallest in our department, using 最.
items.zh: 小王是我们部门最高的。
items.py: xiǎo wáng shì wǒ men bù mén zuì gāo de
items.en: Xiao Wang is the tallest in our department.
items.why: The group 我们部门 goes before 最, and 最 stands right before the adjective.

items.src: 这个问题有一点儿难。
items.src_py: zhè ge wèn tí yǒu yī diǎn r nán
items.task: Say it with 比较 instead of 有一点儿.
items.zh: 这个问题比较难。
items.py: zhè ge wèn tí bǐ jiào nán
items.en: This question is fairly difficult.
items.why: 比较 sits directly before the adjective and names no B.

items.src: 我跑得快，他跑得更快。
items.src_py: wǒ pǎo de kuài tā pǎo de gèng kuài
items.task: Combine into one sentence with 比, starting with 他.
items.zh: 他比我跑得快。
items.py: tā bǐ wǒ pǎo de kuài
items.en: He runs faster than me.
items.why: Both 他比我跑得快 and 他跑得比我快 are correct; 得 must stay after the verb.

items.src: 李医生写字写得很好，小王写字写得不太好。
items.src_py: lǐ yī shēng xiě zì xiě de hěn hǎo xiǎo wáng xiě zì xiě de bù tài hǎo
items.task: Say Dr Li writes better than Xiao Wang, using 比 and starting with 李医生.
items.zh: 李医生写字写得比小王好。
items.py: lǐ yī shēng xiě zì xiě de bǐ xiǎo wáng hǎo
items.en: Dr Li writes better than Xiao Wang.
items.why: The verb is repeated for the object 写字. 比小王 can sit before the first 写字 or the second 写得, or follow 得.

items.src: 我每天七点起床，小王每天八点起床。
items.src_py: wǒ měi tiān qī diǎn qǐ chuáng xiǎo wáng měi tiān bā diǎn qǐ chuáng
items.task: Say I get up earlier than Xiao Wang, using 比 and 得.
items.zh: 我起得比小王早。
items.py: wǒ qǐ de bǐ xiǎo wáng zǎo
items.en: I get up earlier than Xiao Wang.
items.why: 起得 keeps 得 between the verb and the adjective. 比小王 sits before 起得 or right after it.

items.src: 我的工作一天比一天忙。
items.src_py: wǒ de gōng zuò yī tiān bǐ yī tiān máng
items.task: Say it with 越来越.
items.zh: 我的工作越来越忙了。
items.py: wǒ de gōng zuò yuè lái yuè máng le
items.en: My work is getting busier and busier.
items.why: 越来越 stands right before the adjective, with 了 at the end. 一天比一天 is replaced.

items.src: 他的身体一天比一天好。
items.src_py: tā de shēn tǐ yī tiān bǐ yī tiān hǎo
items.task: Say it with 越来越.
items.zh: 他的身体越来越好了。
items.py: tā de shēn tǐ yuè lái yuè hǎo le
items.en: His health is getting better and better.
items.why: 越来越 replaces 一天比一天. No 很 or 更 can be added.

items.src: 他吃得一天比一天少。
items.src_py: tā chī de yī tiān bǐ yī tiān shǎo
items.task: Say it with 越来越 and 得.
items.zh: 他吃得越来越少了。
items.py: tā chī de yuè lái yuè shǎo le
items.en: He's eating less and less.
items.why: After 得, 越来越 comes right before the adjective: 吃得越来越少了.

items.s: 我的办公室比你的很大。
items.s_py: wǒ de bàn gōng shì bǐ nǐ de hěn dà
items.zh: 我的办公室比你的大。
items.py: wǒ de bàn gōng shì bǐ nǐ de dà
items.en: My office is bigger than yours.
items.why: 很 cannot be put before an adjective in a 比 sentence. The adjective stays bare.

items.s: 这个星期比上个星期还忙。
items.s_py: zhè ge xīng qī bǐ shàng ge xīng qī hái máng
items.zh: 这个星期比上个星期还忙。
items.py: zhè ge xīng qī bǐ shàng ge xīng qī hái máng
items.en: This week is even busier than last week.
items.why: 还 is allowed before the adjective in a 比 sentence and means 'even'. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 这个月的会比上个月比较多。
items.s_py: zhè ge yuè de huì bǐ shàng ge yuè bǐ jiào duō
items.zh: 这个月的会比上个月多。
items.py: zhè ge yuè de huì bǐ shàng ge yuè duō
items.en: This month there are more meetings than last month.
items.why: 比较 means 'fairly' and cannot be added to a 比 sentence, which already says 'than'.

items.s: 新同事比我三岁小。
items.s_py: xīn tóng shì bǐ wǒ sān suì xiǎo
items.zh: 新同事比我小三岁。
items.py: xīn tóng shì bǐ wǒ xiǎo sān suì
items.en: The new colleague is three years younger than me.
items.why: The amount of the difference goes after the adjective: 小三岁, not before it as in English.

items.s: 吃了药，他今天比昨天好多了。
items.s_py: chī le yào tā jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān hǎo duō le
items.zh: 吃了药，他今天比昨天好多了。
items.py: chī le yào tā jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān hǎo duō le
items.en: After taking the medicine, he is much better today than yesterday.
items.why: 好多了 is the correct way to say 'much better' in a 比 sentence: the amount comes after the adjective.

items.s: 这家医院比那家医院很远得多。
items.s_py: zhè jiā yī yuàn bǐ nà jiā yī yuàn hěn yuǎn de duō
items.zh: 这家医院比那家医院远得多。
items.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn bǐ nà jiā yī yuàn yuǎn de duō
items.en: This hospital is much farther away than that one.
items.why: 得多 already gives 'much'. 很 cannot stand before the adjective in a 比 sentence.

items.s: 新同事比我不忙。
items.s_py: xīn tóng shì bǐ wǒ bù máng
items.zh: 新同事没有我忙。
items.py: xīn tóng shì méi yǒu wǒ máng
items.en: The new colleague isn't as busy as I am.
items.why: 'Not as busy as' is 没有 B + adjective. 比 is not negated at the adjective.

items.s: 这个星期的会没有上个星期那么多。
items.s_py: zhè ge xīng qī de huì méi yǒu shàng ge xīng qī nà me duō
items.zh: 这个星期的会没有上个星期那么多。
items.py: zhè ge xīng qī de huì méi yǒu shàng ge xīng qī nà me duō
items.en: This week there are not as many meetings as last week.
items.why: 没有 B 那么 + adjective is correct for 'not as ... as'.

items.s: 我的手机不如你的很好。
items.s_py: wǒ de shǒu jī bù rú nǐ de hěn hǎo
items.zh: 我的手机不如你的好。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī bù rú nǐ de hǎo
items.en: My phone is not as good as yours.
items.why: 不如 B takes a bare adjective, never 很. 不如 already says 'not as good as', so no degree word can be added.

items.s: 这个方案不比那个方案好，只是便宜一点儿。
items.s_py: zhè ge fāng àn bù bǐ nà ge fāng àn hǎo zhǐ shì pián yi yī diǎn r
items.zh: 这个方案不比那个方案好，只是便宜一点儿。
items.py: zhè ge fāng àn bù bǐ nà ge fāng àn hǎo zhǐ shì pián yi yī diǎn r
items.en: This plan is no better than that one, it is just a little cheaper.
items.why: 不比 means 'no more than' and allows the two to be equal, which fits 'only a little cheaper'.

items.s: 我的汉语比不如他。
items.s_py: wǒ de hàn yǔ bǐ bù rú tā
items.zh: 我的汉语不如他。
items.py: wǒ de hàn yǔ bù rú tā
items.en: My Chinese is not as good as his.
items.why: 不如 replaces 比. The two cannot be combined.

items.s: 我的工作比你的一样忙。
items.s_py: wǒ de gōng zuò bǐ nǐ de yī yàng máng
items.zh: 我的工作跟你的一样忙。
items.py: wǒ de gōng zuò gēn nǐ de yī yàng máng
items.en: My job is just as busy as yours.
items.why: 比 marks a difference and cannot go with 一样. Sameness uses 跟 or 和.

items.s: 这两种药的颜色不一样，可是作用一样。
items.s_py: zhè liǎng zhǒng yào de yán sè bù yí yàng kě shì zuò yòng yī yàng
items.zh: 这两种药的颜色不一样，可是作用一样。
items.py: zhè liǎng zhǒng yào de yán sè bù yí yàng kě shì zuò yòng yī yàng
items.en: The colours of these two medicines are different, but they work the same way.
items.why: 不一样 and 一样 can stand alone without an adjective. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 他的血压跟我一样很高，都得吃药。
items.s_py: tā de xuè yā gēn wǒ yī yàng hěn gāo dōu děi chī yào
items.zh: 他的血压跟我一样高，都得吃药。
items.py: tā de xuè yā gēn wǒ yī yàng gāo dōu děi chī yào
items.en: His blood pressure is as high as mine; we both need medicine.
items.why: After 一样 the adjective is bare. 很 cannot be added.

items.s: 这个药比较那个药贵。
items.s_py: zhè ge yào bǐ jiào nà ge yào guì
items.zh: 这个药比那个药贵。
items.py: zhè ge yào bǐ nà ge yào guì
items.en: This medicine is more expensive than that one.
items.why: 比较 before an adjective means 'fairly'. 'Than' is 比 alone.

items.s: 这个星期最忙的人不是我，是小李。
items.s_py: zhè ge xīng qī zuì máng de rén bú shì wǒ shì xiǎo lǐ
items.zh: 这个星期最忙的人不是我，是小李。
items.py: zhè ge xīng qī zuì máng de rén bú shì wǒ shì xiǎo lǐ
items.en: The busiest person this week is not me, it's Xiao Li.
items.why: 最 goes before the adjective and 的 turns it into a noun phrase. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 小王做报告得比我好。
items.s_py: xiǎo wáng zuò bào gào de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.zh: 小王做报告做得比我好。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuò bào gào zuò de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.en: Xiao Wang gives presentations better than I do.
items.why: 得 must follow the verb directly, but here 报告 sits between 做 and 得. Repeat the verb: 做报告做得比我好.

items.s: 弟弟吃得比我多，可是还没我胖。
items.s_py: dì di chī de bǐ wǒ duō kě shì hái méi wǒ pàng
items.zh: 弟弟吃得比我多，可是还没我胖。
items.py: dì di chī de bǐ wǒ duō kě shì hái méi wǒ pàng
items.en: My younger brother eats more than I do, but he's still not as fat as me.
items.why: 吃得比我多 is the correct comparison of an action. 没我胖 is also a valid 没有 comparison.

items.s: 最近天气越来越很热。
items.s_py: zuì jìn tiān qì yuè lái yuè hěn rè
items.zh: 最近天气越来越热。
items.py: zuì jìn tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè
items.en: The weather has been getting hotter and hotter lately.
items.why: 越来越 already gives the degree. 很 cannot follow it.

items.s: 他越来越喜欢这家公司了。
items.s_py: tā yuè lái yuè xǐ huan zhè jiā gōng sī le
items.zh: 他越来越喜欢这家公司了。
items.py: tā yuè lái yuè xǐ huan zhè jiā gōng sī le
items.en: He likes this company more and more.
items.why: 越来越 can stand before a verb of feeling like 喜欢. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 这件衣服___那件贵。
items.zh: 这件衣服比那件贵。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu bǐ nà jiàn guì
items.en: This piece of clothing is more expensive than that one.
items.why: 比 goes between A and the adjective to say 'more than'. 没有 would say 'not as expensive as', 跟 needs 一样, and 最 needs a group of three or more.

items.q: 篮球比足球___好玩。
items.zh: 篮球比足球好玩。
items.py: lán qiú bǐ zú qiú hǎo wán
items.en: Basketball is more fun than football.
items.why: In a 比 sentence the adjective stays bare. 很, 非常 and 太 cannot stand in front of it; only 更 or 还 may, and those are not offered here.

items.q: 这家店的鞋已经很便宜了，那家比这家___便宜。
items.zh: 这家店的鞋已经很便宜了，那家比这家更便宜。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de xié yǐ jīng hěn pián yi le nà jiā bǐ zhè jiā gèng pián yi
items.en: The shoes at this shop are already cheap, and that shop is even cheaper than this one.
items.why: 'Even cheaper than something already cheap' is 比 + 更. 很, 有点儿 and 比较 cannot be put before the adjective of a 比 sentence.

items.q: 虽然这个牌子的手机很贵，但是那个牌子的比这个牌子的___贵。
items.zh: 虽然这个牌子的手机很贵，但是那个牌子的比这个牌子的还贵。
items.py: suī rán zhè ge pái zi de shǒu jī hěn guì dàn shì nà ge pái zi de bǐ zhè ge pái zi de hái guì
items.en: Although this brand of phone is expensive, that brand's is even more expensive than this one's.
items.why: The brand is already dear, so 'even more' needs 还 (or 更) before 贵. 很, 非常 and 太 are never allowed before the adjective after 比.

items.q: 这双鞋比那双便宜___。
items.zh: 这双鞋比那双便宜一点儿。
items.py: zhè shuāng xié bǐ nà shuāng pián yi yī diǎn r
items.en: These shoes are a little cheaper than those.
items.why: A small difference goes after the adjective: 便宜一点儿. 有点儿, 很 and 非常 stand before an adjective and cannot be used in or after a 比 sentence like this.

items.q: 我比哥哥___两岁。
items.zh: 我比哥哥小两岁。
items.py: wǒ bǐ gē ge xiǎo liǎng suì
items.en: I'm two years younger than my older brother.
items.why: The number goes after the adjective: 小两岁. An older brother means I am younger, so 小 fits; 大 would make me older and 高 is about height.

items.q: 这台电脑比那台便宜___，这台只要两千，那台要五千。
items.zh: 这台电脑比那台便宜得多，这台只要两千，那台要五千。
items.py: zhè tái diàn nǎo bǐ nà tái pián yi de duō zhè tái zhǐ yào liǎng qiān nà tái yào wǔ qiān
items.en: This computer is much cheaper than that one: this one costs only two thousand and that one five thousand.
items.why: A big gap (two thousand against five thousand) is 得多 after the adjective. 一点儿 means only slightly, and 有点儿 and 很 do not belong after 便宜 in a 比 sentence.

items.q: 今天的西瓜比昨天的贵___，一斤只贵一毛钱。
items.zh: 今天的西瓜比昨天的贵一点儿，一斤只贵一毛钱。
items.py: jīn tiān de xī guā bǐ zuó tiān de guì yī diǎn r yī jīn zhǐ guì yī máo qián
items.en: Today's watermelon is a little pricier than yesterday's, only one mao more per jin.
items.why: The difference is tiny (one mao), so 一点儿. 得多, 多了 and 很多 all say the gap is big, which contradicts 只贵一毛钱.

items.q: 他篮球打得比我好___，我完全比不上他。
items.zh: 他篮球打得比我好得多，我完全比不上他。
items.py: tā lán qiú dǎ de bǐ wǒ hǎo de duō wǒ wán quán bǐ bu shàng tā
items.en: He plays basketball much better than I do; I can't compare with him at all.
items.why: 'Can't compare at all' needs a big difference: 好得多 after the adjective. 一点儿 and 一些 mean only slightly better, and 点儿 alone is not a complete amount word.

items.q: 我的球拍___他的好。
items.zh: 我的球拍没有他的好。
items.py: wǒ de qiú pāi méi yǒu tā de hǎo
items.en: My racket is not as good as his.
items.why: 'Not as good as' is A 没有 B + adjective. 不 cannot link two nouns like this, 比 would say mine is better, and 跟 needs 一样.

items.q: 今天的菜市场没有周末___热闹。
items.zh: 今天的菜市场没有周末那么热闹。
items.py: jīn tiān de cài shì chǎng méi yǒu zhōu mò nà me rè nao
items.en: The market today is not as lively as at the weekend.
items.why: After 没有 + B only 这么 or 那么 may precede the adjective. 很 cannot be added, and 得多 and 一点儿 cannot follow it in a 没有 sentence.

items.q: 我游泳游得___他快。
items.zh: 我游泳游得没有他快。
items.py: wǒ yóu yǒng yóu de méi yǒu tā kuài
items.en: I don't swim as fast as he does.
items.why: 'Not as fast as' is 没有 + B + adjective, even after verb + 得. 不 and 很 cannot take the place of 没有, and 比 would claim I am faster, against the English.

items.q: 这家网店的东西___别家那么便宜，所以我没买。
items.zh: 这家网店的东西没有别家那么便宜，所以我没买。
items.py: zhè jiā wǎng diàn de dōng xi méi yǒu bié jiā nà me pián yi suǒ yǐ wǒ méi mǎi
items.en: The things at this online shop aren't as cheap as at other shops, so I didn't buy any.
items.why: 那么 before the adjective belongs to the 没有 pattern. 比 and 更 cannot be used with 那么, and 不比 would mean 'no cheaper than', which does not give a reason for not buying.

items.q: 这件衣服___那件好看。
items.zh: 这件衣服没有那件好看。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu méi yǒu nà jiàn hǎo kàn
items.en: This piece of clothing is not as nice as that one.
items.why: 'Not as nice as' is A 没有 B + adjective. 比 would say this one is nicer, 最 needs a group, and 一样 cannot sit between the nouns without 跟.

items.q: 他说他比我高，其实他___我高，我们俩一样高。
items.zh: 他说他比我高，其实他不比我高，我们俩一样高。
items.py: tā shuō tā bǐ wǒ gāo qí shí tā bù bǐ wǒ gāo wǒ men liǎ yī yàng gāo
items.en: He says he is taller than me, but actually he is no taller than I am; we are the same height.
items.why: 不比 means 'not more than', so being equally tall is fine and it corrects a claim. 没有 and 不如 say he is clearly shorter, which clashes with 一样高; 比 would just repeat his claim.

items.q: 买书___借书省钱，图书馆的书不要钱。
items.zh: 买书不如借书省钱，图书馆的书不要钱。
items.py: mǎi shū bù rú jiè shū shěng qián tú shū guǎn de shū bù yào qián
items.en: Buying books is not as money-saving as borrowing them; library books are free.
items.why: A 不如 B + adjective says A is not as good as B in that way. 不 alone cannot link the two actions, and 比 or 更 would say buying saves more, which is the opposite.

items.q: 我的球技___他，所以他当队长。
items.zh: 我的球技不如他，所以他当队长。
items.py: wǒ de qiú jì bù rú tā suǒ yǐ tā dāng duì zhǎng
items.en: My skill isn't as good as his, so he is the captain.
items.why: A 不如 B works without an adjective: 'A is not as good as B'. 不 and 没 cannot stand directly in front of 他 here, and 比 would say I am better, against the reason given.

items.q: 我的球鞋___你的一样。
items.zh: 我的球鞋跟你的一样。
items.py: wǒ de qiú xié gēn nǐ de yī yàng
items.en: My sneakers are the same as yours.
items.why: 'The same as' is 跟/和 + B + 一样. 比 always means a difference, 没有 means less, and 最 is for the top of a group.

items.q: 这两个包的价钱___，都是八十块。
items.zh: 这两个包的价钱一样，都是八十块。
items.py: zhè liǎng ge bāo de jià qián yī yàng dōu shì bā shí kuài
items.en: The two bags cost the same: eighty yuan each.
items.why: Both being eighty yuan makes them the same, so 一样. 不一样 would contradict 都是八十块, and 没有 cannot end the clause without an adjective.

items.q: 他打球打得跟他哥哥___好。
items.zh: 他打球打得跟他哥哥一样好。
items.py: tā dǎ qiú dǎ de gēn tā gē ge yī yàng hǎo
items.en: He plays ball as well as his older brother does.
items.why: 跟 + B + 一样 + adjective says 'as ... as'. 比 cannot follow 跟, 很 cannot replace 一样, and 没有 cannot follow 跟.

items.q: 网上的价格___商店里的一样，所以我在网上买，不用出门。
items.zh: 网上的价格跟商店里的一样，所以我在网上买，不用出门。
items.py: wǎng shàng de jià gé gēn shāng diàn lǐ de yī yàng suǒ yǐ wǒ zài wǎng shàng mǎi bù yòng chū mén
items.en: Online prices are the same as in the shops, so I buy online and don't need to go out.
items.why: 一样 needs 跟 or 和 in front of the thing compared. 比, 更 and 最 cannot combine with 一样 and would describe a difference.

items.q: 这家店的运动服看起来跟那家的一样，可是价格___，这家贵多了。
items.zh: 这家店的运动服看起来跟那家的一样，可是价格不一样，这家贵多了。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de yùn dòng fú kàn qǐ lái gēn nà jiā de yī yàng kě shì jià gé bù yī yàng zhè jiā guì duō le
items.en: The sports clothes in this shop look the same as that shop's, but the prices are different: this one is much more expensive.
items.why: 可是 signals a contrast, and 贵多了 shows the prices differ, so 不一样. 一样 would repeat the first clause, and 没有 cannot end the clause alone.

items.q: 我们班他篮球打得___好。
items.zh: 我们班他篮球打得最好。
items.py: wǒ men bān tā lán qiú dǎ de zuì hǎo
items.en: In our class he plays basketball best.
items.why: The group 我们班 is named first and 最 sits right before the adjective for 'the best'. 更 needs something already mentioned, 很 only says 'very', and 比 needs a B.

items.q: 三种运动里，我___喜欢游泳。
items.zh: 三种运动里，我最喜欢游泳。
items.py: sān zhǒng yùn dòng lǐ wǒ zuì xǐ huan yóu yǒng
items.en: Of the three sports, I like swimming best.
items.why: 'Best of a group of three' is 最 before 喜欢. 比 needs a B, 很 does not pick one out of three, and 太 would mean 'too much'.

items.q: 这个背包已经很便宜了，那个___便宜，只要三十块。
items.zh: 这个背包已经很便宜了，那个更便宜，只要三十块。
items.py: zhè ge bēi bāo yǐ jīng hěn pián yi le nà ge gèng pián yi zhǐ yào sān shí kuài
items.en: This bag is already cheap, and that one is even cheaper: only thirty yuan.
items.why: 更 means 'even more' than something just mentioned. 最 would crown it the cheapest of all, 比较 means 'fairly', and 很 gives no extra step beyond the first bag.

items.q: 这个周末天气___好，我们去打球吧。
items.zh: 这个周末天气比较好，我们去打球吧。
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò tiān qì bǐ jiào hǎo wǒ men qù dǎ qiú ba
items.en: The weather this weekend is fairly good, so let's go play ball.
items.why: No second item is named, so 比较 ('fairly') goes before 好. 比 would need a B, and 更 and 最 mean 'even more' and 'most'.

items.q: 这三双鞋里红色的___好看，另外两双都没有它好看。
items.zh: 这三双鞋里红色的最好看，另外两双都没有它好看。
items.py: zhè sān shuāng xié lǐ hóng sè de zuì hǎo kàn lìng wài liǎng shuāng dōu méi yǒu tā hǎo kàn
items.en: Of these three pairs, the red ones are the nicest; the other two aren't as nice.
items.why: The group 这三双鞋里 comes first and 最 sits before the adjective. 比 needs a B, 没有 would say the red pair is the one that is not as nice, and 一样 cannot stand before 好看.

items.q: 他跑___比我快。
items.zh: 他跑得比我快。
items.py: tā pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài
items.en: He runs faster than I do.
items.why: How an action is done needs 得 after the verb, also when 比 comes in between. 的 and 地 are other particles, and 了 does not link a verb to its manner.

items.q: 他踢足球___得比我好。
items.zh: 他踢足球踢得比我好。
items.py: tā tī zú qiú tī de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.en: He plays football better than I do.
items.why: With an object, the verb is repeated before 得: 踢足球踢得. Leaving out the second verb gives 踢足球得, which is not possible, and 打 or 做 do not go with 足球 here.

items.q: 弟弟每天都练习，现在他游泳游___比我快多了。
items.zh: 弟弟每天都练习，现在他游泳游得比我快多了。
items.py: dì di měi tiān dōu liàn xí xiàn zài tā yóu yǒng yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le
items.en: My younger brother practises every day, and now he swims much faster than I do.
items.why: Verb + 得 + 比我 + adjective is the pattern for comparing an action. 了, 着 and 的 cannot join the verb 游 to 比我快, and the amount 多了 still comes last.

items.q: 秋天到了，天气___冷了。
items.zh: 秋天到了，天气越来越冷了。
items.py: qiū tiān dào le tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le
items.en: Autumn has come and the weather is getting colder and colder.
items.why: 'More and more' is the whole pattern 越来越 before the adjective, with 了 at the end. 越来 is incomplete, and 很 or 有点儿 describe a state rather than a change.

items.q: 我越来越___跑步了。
items.zh: 我越来越喜欢跑步了。
items.py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan pǎo bù le
items.en: I like running more and more.
items.why: 越来越 already carries the degree, so 喜欢 follows it directly. 很, 更 and 太 cannot be stacked behind 越来越.

items.q: 网上购物的人___多了。
items.zh: 网上购物的人越来越多了。
items.py: wǎng shàng gòu wù de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
items.en: More and more people shop online.
items.why: The idea 'more and more' is 越来越 right before 多, usually with 了. 最 and 比 need a group or a B, and 很多了 says nothing about growth.

items.q: 他练了半年以后，投篮投得___准了。
items.zh: 他练了半年以后，投篮投得越来越准了。
items.py: tā liàn le bàn nián yǐ hòu tóu lán tóu de yuè lái yuè zhǔn le
items.en: After half a year of practice, his shooting has become more and more accurate.
items.why: With an action verb 越来越 goes after 得 and directly before the adjective. Adding 更 or 很, or putting 很 in front, breaks the pattern.

items.q: 弟弟比我___高。
items.zh: 弟弟比我高。
items.py: dì di bǐ wǒ gāo
items.en: My younger brother is taller than me.
items.why: The adjective after 比 is bare. 很, 非常 and 太 may not stand before it, so nothing is inserted: 比我高.

items.zh: 打球比看球有意思。
items.py: dǎ qiú bǐ kàn qiú yǒu yì si
items.en: Playing ball is more fun than watching it.
items.why: A 比 B + adjective: the 比 phrase sits before the adjective, not after it as in English 'than'.

items.zh: 他的球拍比我的更好。
items.py: tā de qiú pāi bǐ wǒ de gèng hǎo
items.en: His racket is even better than mine.
items.why: 更 sits right before the adjective, after the 比 phrase. 比 B must come before it, not at the end.

items.zh: 商场里的东西比网上的更贵。
items.py: shāng chǎng lǐ de dōng xi bǐ wǎng shàng de gèng guì
items.en: Things in the mall are even more expensive than those online.
items.why: The 比 phrase comes right after the subject and 更 right before 贵; 贵 stays last.

items.zh: 姐姐比我大两岁。
items.py: jiě jie bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì
items.en: My older sister is two years older than me.
items.why: The size of the age gap goes after the adjective: 大两岁, never 两岁大.

items.zh: 这条裤子比那条便宜二十块。
items.py: zhè tiáo kù zi bǐ nà tiáo pián yi èr shí kuài
items.en: These trousers are twenty yuan cheaper than that pair.
items.why: The exact difference follows the adjective: 便宜二十块. Putting it before 便宜 is the English order and is wrong.

items.zh: 今年的票价比去年贵得多。
items.py: jīn nián de piào jià bǐ qù nián guì de duō
items.en: This year's ticket price is much higher than last year's.
items.why: 比 去年 comes before the adjective, and 得多 for 'much' attaches after the adjective at the end.

items.zh: 在网上买比在商店买便宜一些。
items.py: zài wǎng shàng mǎi bǐ zài shāng diàn mǎi pián yi yī xiē
items.en: Buying online is a bit cheaper than buying in a shop.
items.why: The verb phrases are compared with 比, and the small difference 一些 goes after 便宜.

items.zh: 我没有哥哥高。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu gē ge gāo
items.en: I'm not as tall as my older brother.
items.why: 'Not as tall as' is A 没有 B + adjective; the adjective stays last and carries no 很.

items.zh: 今天的比赛没有昨天的那么精彩。
items.py: jīn tiān de bǐ sài méi yǒu zuó tiān de nà me jīng cǎi
items.en: Today's match is not as exciting as yesterday's.
items.why: 那么 comes between B and the adjective in the 没有 pattern; it cannot go before 没有.

items.zh: 跑步没有游泳那么累。
items.py: pǎo bù méi yǒu yóu yǒng nà me lèi
items.en: Running is not as tiring as swimming.
items.why: A 没有 B 那么 adjective: 那么 is placed right before 累, after B.

items.zh: 这个牌子不比那个牌子贵。
items.py: zhè ge pái zi bù bǐ nà ge pái zi guì
items.en: This brand is no more expensive than that one.
items.why: 不 goes in front of 比, not in front of the adjective: 不比 B 贵. 比 B 不贵 is wrong.

items.zh: 网上买东西不如在店里买放心。
items.py: wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xi bù rú zài diàn lǐ mǎi fàng xīn
items.en: Buying online isn't as reassuring as buying in a shop.
items.why: A 不如 B + adjective takes a good quality such as 放心; 不如 B stands before the adjective.

items.zh: 我跟你一样高。
items.py: wǒ gēn nǐ yī yàng gāo
items.en: I'm as tall as you.
items.why: 跟 + B + 一样 + adjective. 一样 follows B and the bare adjective comes last, with no 很.

items.zh: 我的球拍和你的一样。
items.py: wǒ de qiú pāi hé nǐ de yī yàng
items.en: My racket is the same as yours.
items.why: 和 B 一样 comes after the subject; 一样 is the last word when no adjective is added.

items.zh: 网上的价格跟商店里的一样便宜。
items.py: wǎng shàng de jià gé gēn shāng diàn lǐ de yī yàng pián yi
items.en: Online prices are as cheap as those in shops.
items.why: 跟 B 一样 sits before the adjective 便宜; the adjective stays bare.

items.zh: 我最喜欢踢足球。
items.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan tī zú qiú
items.en: I like playing football best.
items.why: 最 goes directly before 喜欢, not after the verb or at the end.

items.zh: 小王是我们队最高的。
items.py: xiǎo wáng shì wǒ men duì zuì gāo de
items.en: Xiao Wang is the tallest on our team.
items.why: The group 我们队 comes before 最, unlike English 'tallest in our team'.

items.zh: 这个篮球比较贵，但是质量很好。
items.py: zhè ge lán qiú bǐ jiào guì dàn shì zhì liàng hěn hǎo
items.en: This basketball is fairly expensive, but the quality is very good.
items.why: 比较 means 'fairly' and sits right before 贵, with no B named.

items.zh: 妹妹说汉语说得比我好。
items.py: mèi mei shuō hàn yǔ shuō de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.en: My younger sister speaks Chinese better than I do.
items.why: With an object the verb repeats; 比我 may sit before the first verb, before the second verb or after 得, but the adjective stays last.

items.zh: 姐姐跑得比我快多了。
items.py: jiě jie pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le
items.en: My older sister runs much faster than I do.
items.why: The amount 多了 goes at the very end after the adjective; 比我 may come before 跑得 or after it.

items.zh: 弟弟吃得比我多。
items.py: dì di chī de bǐ wǒ duō
items.en: My younger brother eats more than I do.
items.why: 得 stays with the verb, 比我 sits before the verb or after 得, and 多 closes the sentence.

items.zh: 天气越来越热了。
items.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè le
items.en: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.
items.why: 越来越 sits right before the adjective, with 了 at the end to mark the change.

items.zh: 我越来越喜欢骑自行车了。
items.py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan qí zì xíng chē le
items.en: I like cycling more and more.
items.why: 越来越 goes between the subject and 喜欢, with no 很 or 更.

items.zh: 他打网球打得越来越好了。
items.py: tā dǎ wǎng qiú dǎ de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
items.en: He plays tennis better and better.
items.why: With an action verb 越来越 follows 得 and comes directly before the adjective.

items.src: 这件五十块，那件八十块。
items.src_py: zhè jiàn wǔ shí kuài nà jiàn bā shí kuài
items.task: Say that one is more expensive than this one, using 比.
items.zh: 那件比这件贵。
items.py: nà jiàn bǐ zhè jiàn guì
items.en: That one is more expensive than this one.
items.why: The 比 phrase goes before the adjective, and 贵 stays bare, with no 很.

items.src: 我们的球队很强，他们的球队更强。
items.src_py: wǒ men de qiú duì hěn qiáng tā men de qiú duì gèng qiáng
items.task: Join the two ideas into one sentence with 比 and 更.
items.zh: 他们的球队比我们的更强。
items.py: tā men de qiú duì bǐ wǒ men de gèng qiáng
items.en: Their team is even stronger than ours.
items.why: 更 stays before the adjective after the 比 phrase. 很 cannot be kept.

items.src: 我比他矮。
items.src_py: wǒ bǐ tā ǎi
items.task: Say 'I'm not as tall as he is' with 没有.
items.zh: 我没有他高。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu tā gāo
items.en: I'm not as tall as he is.
items.why: 'Not as tall as' is A 没有 B + the big-end adjective 高, not 比 with 不.

items.src: 在网上买比在商店买便宜。
items.src_py: zài wǎng shàng mǎi bǐ zài shāng diàn mǎi pián yi
items.task: Say buying in a shop is not as cheap as buying online, using 没有.
items.zh: 在商店买没有在网上买便宜。
items.py: zài shāng diàn mǎi méi yǒu zài wǎng shàng mǎi pián yi
items.en: Buying in a shop is not as cheap as buying online.
items.why: The two items swap places: the shop is A and online is B, joined by 没有 with the adjective last.

items.src: 这个二十块，那个也二十块。
items.src_py: zhè ge èr shí kuài nà ge yě èr shí kuài
items.task: Say they cost the same, using 跟 ... 一样.
items.zh: 这个跟那个一样贵。
items.py: zhè ge gēn nà ge yī yàng guì
items.en: This one is as expensive as that one.
items.why: Equal prices are 跟 B 一样 + adjective, with a bare adjective and no 比.

items.src: 我的球衣跟你的一样。
items.src_py: wǒ de qiú yī gēn nǐ de yī yàng
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 我的球衣跟你的不一样。
items.py: wǒ de qiú yī gēn nǐ de bù yī yàng
items.en: My jersey is different from yours.
items.why: The negative is 不一样, with 不 right in front of 一样.

items.src: 这本书四十块，那本书七十块。
items.src_py: zhè běn shū sì shí kuài nà běn shū qī shí kuài
items.task: Say that one is thirty yuan more expensive, using 比.
items.zh: 那本书比这本书贵三十块。
items.py: nà běn shū bǐ zhè běn shū guì sān shí kuài
items.en: That book is thirty yuan more expensive than this one.
items.why: The exact amount goes after the adjective: 贵三十块.

items.src: 这个球拍比那个贵很多。
items.src_py: zhè ge qiú pāi bǐ nà ge guì hěn duō
items.task: Say 'much more expensive' with 得多.
items.zh: 这个球拍比那个贵得多。
items.py: zhè ge qiú pāi bǐ nà ge guì de duō
items.en: This racket is much more expensive than that one.
items.why: 得多 attaches directly to the adjective after the 比 phrase.

items.src: 这家店的价格没有那家便宜。
items.src_py: zhè jiā diàn de jià gé méi yǒu nà jiā pián yi
items.task: Say the same thing with 不如.
items.zh: 这家店的价格不如那家便宜。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de jià gé bù rú nà jiā pián yi
items.en: The prices in this shop are not as cheap as in that one.
items.why: 不如 replaces 没有 and takes the good adjective 便宜 after B.

items.src: 在所有的水果里，我特别喜欢苹果。
items.src_py: zài suǒ yǒu de shuǐ guǒ lǐ wǒ tè bié xǐ huan píng guǒ
items.task: Say I like apples best, using 最.
items.zh: 我最喜欢苹果。
items.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan píng guǒ
items.en: I like apples best.
items.why: 最 goes right before 喜欢.

items.src: 这个商场的人很多。
items.src_py: zhè ge shāng chǎng de rén hěn duō
items.task: Say there are fairly many people, using 比较.
items.zh: 这个商场的人比较多。
items.py: zhè ge shāng chǎng de rén bǐ jiào duō
items.en: There are fairly many people in this shopping mall.
items.why: 比较 replaces 很 in the same slot before the adjective and does not need a B.

items.src: 她比我游得快。
items.src_py: tā bǐ wǒ yóu de kuài
items.task: Move 比我 so that it comes after 得.
items.zh: 她游得比我快。
items.py: tā yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài
items.en: She swims faster than I do.
items.why: Both positions of 比我 are correct and mean the same; 得 stays with the verb.

items.src: 我踢足球踢得不好，哥哥踢得很好。
items.src_py: wǒ tī zú qiú tī de bù hǎo gē ge tī de hěn hǎo
items.task: Say my older brother plays better than I do, using 比.
items.zh: 哥哥踢足球踢得比我好。
items.py: gē ge tī zú qiú tī de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.en: My older brother plays football better than I do.
items.why: With an object the verb repeats before 得, and 比我 can sit before the first verb, before the second verb or after 得.

items.src: 我跑得比他快。
items.src_py: wǒ pǎo de bǐ tā kuài
items.task: Say he does not run as fast as I do, using 没有.
items.zh: 他跑得没有我快。
items.py: tā pǎo de méi yǒu wǒ kuài
items.en: He doesn't run as fast as I do.
items.why: 没有 + B takes the slot of 比 + B; 得 stays and the adjective stays bare.

items.src: 城市里的人一年比一年多。
items.src_py: chéng shì lǐ de rén yī nián bǐ yī nián duō
items.task: Say it with 越来越.
items.zh: 城市里的人越来越多了。
items.py: chéng shì lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
items.en: There are more and more people in the city.
items.why: 越来越 goes right before 多, with 了 at the end.

items.src: 他打篮球打得很好。
items.src_py: tā dǎ lán qiú dǎ de hěn hǎo
items.task: Say he plays better and better, with 越来越.
items.zh: 他打篮球打得越来越好了。
items.py: tā dǎ lán qiú dǎ de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
items.en: He plays basketball better and better.
items.why: 越来越 replaces 很 and follows 得 directly before the adjective.

items.src: 我喜欢这个运动。
items.src_py: wǒ xǐ huan zhè ge yùn dòng
items.task: Say I like it more and more, with 越来越.
items.zh: 我越来越喜欢这个运动了。
items.py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan zhè ge yùn dòng le
items.en: I like this sport more and more.
items.why: 越来越 goes before the verb of feeling 喜欢, with 了 at the end.

items.src: 这家超市的水果很新鲜，那家超市的水果更新鲜。
items.src_py: zhè jiā chāo shì de shuǐ guǒ hěn xīn xiān nà jiā chāo shì de shuǐ guǒ gèng xīn xiān
items.task: Combine into one sentence with 比 and 更.
items.zh: 那家超市的水果比这家的更新鲜。
items.py: nà jiā chāo shì de shuǐ guǒ bǐ zhè jiā de gèng xīn xiān
items.en: The fruit at that supermarket is even fresher than this one's.
items.why: The repeated noun after 比 is dropped (这家的), and 更 stays before 新鲜 while 很 disappears.

items.src: 小王一米八，我一米七五。
items.src_py: xiǎo wáng yī mǐ bā wǒ yī mǐ qī wǔ
items.task: Say Xiao Wang is five centimetres taller, using 比.
items.zh: 小王比我高五厘米。
items.py: xiǎo wáng bǐ wǒ gāo wǔ lí mǐ
items.en: Xiao Wang is five centimetres taller than me.
items.why: The exact difference goes after the adjective: 高五厘米.

items.s: 这双球鞋比那双很贵。
items.s_py: zhè shuāng qiú xié bǐ nà shuāng hěn guì
items.zh: 这双球鞋比那双贵。
items.py: zhè shuāng qiú xié bǐ nà shuāng guì
items.en: These sneakers are more expensive than those.
items.why: 很 cannot stand before the adjective in a 比 sentence. The adjective stays bare, or 更 or 还 is used for 'even'.

items.s: 这个牌子的衣服比那个牌子的还贵。
items.zh: 这个牌子的衣服比那个牌子的还贵。
items.py: zhè ge pái zi de yī fu bǐ nà ge pái zi de hái guì
items.en: Clothes of this brand are even more expensive than that brand's.
items.why: 还 is one of the two adverbs allowed before the adjective in a 比 sentence, meaning 'even'. Only 很, 非常 and 太 are ruled out.

items.s: 他的篮球比我的非常新。
items.s_py: tā de lán qiú bǐ wǒ de fēi cháng xīn
items.zh: 他的篮球比我的新。
items.py: tā de lán qiú bǐ wǒ de xīn
items.en: His basketball is newer than mine.
items.why: 非常 is a degree word and cannot sit before the adjective after 比. Keep the adjective bare.

items.s: 这件比那件有点儿便宜。
items.s_py: zhè jiàn bǐ nà jiàn yǒu diǎn r pián yi
items.zh: 这件比那件便宜一点儿。
items.py: zhè jiàn bǐ nà jiàn pián yi yī diǎn r
items.en: This one is a little cheaper than that one.
items.why: 有点儿 goes before an adjective and does not fit a 比 sentence. The amount of difference is 一点儿, after the adjective.

items.s: 今年的票比去年的贵得多。
items.zh: 今年的票比去年的贵得多。
items.py: jīn nián de piào bǐ qù nián de guì de duō
items.en: This year's tickets are much more expensive than last year's.
items.why: 得多 after the adjective is the right way to say 'much more' in a 比 sentence; it replaces the impossible 很 before the adjective.

items.s: 我比弟弟三岁大。
items.s_py: wǒ bǐ dì di sān suì dà
items.zh: 我比弟弟大三岁。
items.py: wǒ bǐ dì di dà sān suì
items.en: I'm three years older than my younger brother.
items.why: The number of years goes after the adjective: 大三岁. 三岁大 follows English word order and is not Chinese.

items.s: 这个比那个便宜一点儿，可是质量好多了。
items.zh: 这个比那个便宜一点儿，可是质量好多了。
items.py: zhè ge bǐ nà ge pián yi yī diǎn r kě shì zhì liàng hǎo duō le
items.en: This one is a bit cheaper than that one, but the quality is much better.
items.why: Both amount words follow the adjective: 一点儿 for a little, 多了 for a lot. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 这家的衣服没有那家的那么好看。
items.zh: 这家的衣服没有那家的那么好看。
items.py: zhè jiā de yī fu méi yǒu nà jiā de nà me hǎo kàn
items.en: Clothes at this shop are not as nice as at that one.
items.why: 没有 + B + 那么 + adjective is the standard pattern for 'not as ... as'. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 今天没有昨天热得多。
items.s_py: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān rè de duō
items.zh: 今天没有昨天那么热。
items.py: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me rè
items.en: Today is not as hot as yesterday.
items.why: After 没有 the adjective takes no amount or 得多 complement; 那么 may stand before it.

items.s: 你说他的球技很好，可我觉得他不比我好。
items.zh: 你说他的球技很好，可我觉得他不比我好。
items.py: nǐ shuō tā de qiú jì hěn hǎo kě wǒ jué de tā bù bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.en: You say his skill is great, but I think he's no better than I am.
items.why: 不比 is the natural way to disagree: 'no better than me'. 不 goes before 比, not before the adjective.

items.s: 这个手机比不如那个好用。
items.s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī bǐ bù rú nà ge hǎo yòng
items.zh: 这个手机不如那个好用。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī bù rú nà ge hǎo yòng
items.en: This phone is not as easy to use as that one.
items.why: 不如 replaces 比; the two cannot be stacked. 'A not as good as B' is A 不如 B + adjective.

items.s: 他的球拍比我的一样新。
items.s_py: tā de qiú pāi bǐ wǒ de yī yàng xīn
items.zh: 他的球拍跟我的一样新。
items.py: tā de qiú pāi gēn wǒ de yī yàng xīn
items.en: His racket is as new as mine.
items.why: 比 always marks a difference. Sameness takes 跟 or 和 with 一样.

items.s: 我的球拍一样贵跟你的。
items.s_py: wǒ de qiú pāi yī yàng guì gēn nǐ de
items.zh: 我的球拍跟你的一样贵。
items.py: wǒ de qiú pāi gēn nǐ de yī yàng guì
items.en: My racket is as expensive as yours.
items.why: 跟 + B must come before 一样 and the adjective, never after them: 跟你的一样贵. Leaving B at the end is not Chinese.

items.s: 现在跑步的人越来越多了。
items.zh: 现在跑步的人越来越多了。
items.py: xiàn zài pǎo bù de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
items.en: More and more people run these days.
items.why: 越来越 goes right before the adjective 多, with 了 at the end. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 他是最高在我们队。
items.s_py: tā shì zuì gāo zài wǒ men duì
items.zh: 他是我们队最高的。
items.py: tā shì wǒ men duì zuì gāo de
items.en: He is the tallest on our team.
items.why: The group goes before 最: 我们队最高的. English 'tallest in our team' puts it after.

items.s: 这家商店的东西比较那家便宜。
items.s_py: zhè jiā shāng diàn de dōng xi bǐ jiào nà jiā pián yi
items.zh: 这家商店的东西比那家便宜。
items.py: zhè jiā shāng diàn de dōng xi bǐ nà jiā pián yi
items.en: Things in this shop are cheaper than in that one.
items.why: 比较 means 'fairly' and takes no B. 'Than' is 比 alone.

items.s: 他比我游快。
items.s_py: tā bǐ wǒ yóu kuài
items.zh: 他比我游得快。
items.py: tā bǐ wǒ yóu de kuài
items.en: He swims faster than I do.
items.why: The manner of an action needs 得 between verb and adjective, also in a comparison.

items.s: 妹妹爬山爬得比我快。
items.zh: 妹妹爬山爬得比我快。
items.py: mèi mei pá shān pá de bǐ wǒ kuài
items.en: My younger sister climbs hills faster than I do.
items.why: With an object the verb repeats, and 比我 may stand right after 得. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 网上购物越来越很方便了。
items.s_py: wǎng shàng gòu wù yuè lái yuè hěn fāng biàn le
items.zh: 网上购物越来越方便了。
items.py: wǎng shàng gòu wù yuè lái yuè fāng biàn le
items.en: Online shopping is getting more and more convenient.
items.why: 越来越 already gives the degree, so 很 cannot be added before the adjective.

items.q: 昨天已经很热了，今天比昨天___热，大家都不想出门。
items.zh: 昨天已经很热了，今天比昨天还热，大家都不想出门。
items.py: zuó tiān yǐ jīng hěn rè le jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān hái rè dà jiā dōu bù xiǎng chū mén
items.en: It was already hot yesterday, and today is even hotter than yesterday; nobody wants to go out.
items.why: In a 比 sentence only 更 or 还 may stand before the adjective, here meaning 'even hotter'. 很, 太 and 有点儿 cannot be placed there.

items.q: 这个周末比上个周末___冷。
items.zh: 这个周末比上个周末冷。
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò bǐ shàng gè zhōu mò lěng
items.en: This weekend is colder than last weekend.
items.why: After 比 B the adjective stands bare, so nothing goes before 冷. 很 and 非常 are degree words that clash with 比.

items.q: 虽然秋天早上已经很凉快，但是冬天早上比秋天___冷，我们只好穿羽绒服。
items.zh: 虽然秋天早上已经很凉快，但是冬天早上比秋天更冷，我们只好穿羽绒服。
items.py: suī rán qiū tiān zǎo shàng yǐ jīng hěn liáng kuai dàn shì dōng tiān zǎo shàng bǐ qiū tiān gèng lěng wǒ men zhǐ hǎo chuān yǔ róng fú
items.en: Autumn mornings are already cool, but winter mornings are even colder than autumn ones, so we had to put on down jackets.
items.why: 更 is the degree word that fits a 比 sentence and means 'even colder'. 非常, 太 and 比较 cannot be put before the adjective once 比 is used.

items.q: 今年冬天比去年冷___，去年穿一件毛衣就够了，今年得穿羽绒服。
items.zh: 今年冬天比去年冷得多，去年穿一件毛衣就够了，今年得穿羽绒服。
items.py: jīn nián dōng tiān bǐ qù nián lěng de duō qù nián chuān yī jiàn máo yī jiù gòu le jīn nián děi chuān yǔ róng fú
items.en: This winter is much colder than last winter; last year one sweater was enough, this year I need a down jacket.
items.why: A big difference is 得多 after the adjective. 一点儿 means only a little and clashes with the context, and 很 or 有点儿 cannot follow the adjective.

items.q: 我家比朋友家离公司近___，只差五分钟的路。
items.zh: 我家比朋友家离公司近一点儿，只差五分钟的路。
items.py: wǒ jiā bǐ péng you jiā lí gōng sī jìn yī diǎn r zhǐ chà wǔ fēn zhōng de lù
items.en: My home is a bit closer to the office than my friend's; it is only five minutes' difference.
items.why: A small difference is 一点儿 after the adjective. 多了 would mean 'much closer', which the five-minute gap contradicts, and 很 or 有点儿 cannot go after the adjective.

items.q: 我弟弟比我小___，他今年才十八。
items.zh: 我弟弟比我小三岁，他今年才十八。
items.py: wǒ dì di bǐ wǒ xiǎo sān suì tā jīn nián cái shí bā
items.en: My younger brother is three years younger than me; he is only eighteen this year.
items.why: An exact age gap is number + 岁 placed after 小. 三个岁 is never said, and 有点儿 cannot follow the adjective.

items.q: 这家饭馆比那家便宜___，我们去这家吧。
items.zh: 这家饭馆比那家便宜十块，我们去这家吧。
items.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn bǐ nà jiā pián yi shí kuài wǒ men qù zhè jiā ba
items.en: This restaurant is ten yuan cheaper than that one; let's go to this one.
items.why: The size of the difference follows the adjective: 便宜十块. 很 and 有点儿 cannot go after the adjective.

items.q: 听说下个月的天气会比这个月凉快___，到时候我们再约朋友去爬山吧。
items.zh: 听说下个月的天气会比这个月凉快一些，到时候我们再约朋友去爬山吧。
items.py: tīng shuō xià gè yuè de tiān qì huì bǐ zhè ge yuè liáng kuai yī xiē dào shí hou wǒ men zài yuē péng you qù pá shān ba
items.en: I hear next month will be a bit cooler than this month; let's invite friends to go hiking then.
items.why: A small difference after the adjective is 一点儿 or 一些, here 凉快一些. 有点儿, 很 and 非常 all go before an adjective (or not at all in a 比 sentence), never after it.

items.q: 今天___昨天那么冷，不用穿厚外套。
items.zh: 今天没有昨天那么冷，不用穿厚外套。
items.py: jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān nà me lěng bù yòng chuān hòu wài tào
items.en: Today is not as cold as yesterday; you don't need a thick coat.
items.why: 'Not as ... as' is A 没有 B 那么 + adjective. 比 would say it is colder, and 不比 or 不如 do not take 那么 + adjective this way.

items.q: 今年的春天没有去年___暖和，花还没开呢。
items.zh: 今年的春天没有去年那么暖和，花还没开呢。
items.py: jīn nián de chūn tiān méi yǒu qù nián nà me nuǎn huo huā hái méi kāi ne
items.en: This spring is not as warm as last spring; the flowers haven't bloomed yet.
items.why: After 没有 B only 这么 or 那么 may come before the adjective. 很, 非常 and 更 cannot be used in this slot.

items.q: 我跑得没有他___快，所以每次比赛都输。
items.zh: 我跑得没有他那么快，所以每次比赛都输。
items.py: wǒ pǎo de méi yǒu tā nà me kuài suǒ yǐ měi cì bǐ sài dōu shū
items.en: I don't run as fast as he does, so I lose every race.
items.why: With 没有 the adjective stays plain and may take 那么 before it. 很 cannot come before it, and amounts such as 得多 or 一点儿 cannot follow it.

items.q: 虽然预报说有大雨，但是真正下起来，雨没有预报说的___大，我们还是出发了。
items.zh: 虽然预报说有大雨，但是真正下起来，雨没有预报说的那么大，我们还是出发了。
items.py: suī rán yù bào shuō yǒu dà yǔ dàn shì zhēn zhèng xià qǐ lái yǔ méi yǒu yù bào shuō de nà me dà wǒ men hái shì chū fā le
items.en: The forecast said heavy rain, but when it actually came, the rain was not as heavy as forecast, so we set off anyway.
items.why: 没有 B 那么 + adjective expresses 'not as ... as'. 很, 比较 and 更 cannot replace 那么 inside a 没有 comparison.

items.q: 你说今天比昨天热？我觉得今天___昨天热，都是三十五度。
items.zh: 你说今天比昨天热？我觉得今天不比昨天热，都是三十五度。
items.py: nǐ shuō jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān rè wǒ jué de jīn tiān bù bǐ zuó tiān rè dōu shì sān shí wǔ dù
items.en: You say today is hotter than yesterday? I think today is no hotter than yesterday; both are thirty-five degrees.
items.why: 不比 means 'not more than' and allows equality, which fits 'both thirty-five'. 没有 and 不如 say it is clearly less, and 比 says it is more.

items.q: 春天风太大了，出去玩还___在家看电影舒服。
items.zh: 春天风太大了，出去玩还不如在家看电影舒服。
items.py: chūn tiān fēng tài dà le chū qù wán hái bù rú zài jiā kàn diàn yǐng shū fu
items.en: The wind is too strong in spring; going out is not as pleasant as watching a film at home.
items.why: 还不如 means 'not even as good as'. 比 or 更 would claim going out is more comfortable, which the strong wind contradicts.

items.q: 他的汉语不如我___，所以他很羡慕我。
items.zh: 他的汉语不如我好，所以他很羡慕我。
items.py: tā de hàn yǔ bù rú wǒ hǎo suǒ yǐ tā hěn xiàn mù wǒ
items.en: His Chinese is not as good as mine, so he envies me.
items.why: After 不如 the adjective must be a positive one: 不如我好. A negative word like 差 or 不好 reverses the meaning and does not fit 'not as good as mine'.

items.q: 今天的雨不如昨天___，路上不难走。
items.zh: 今天的雨不如昨天大，路上不难走。
items.py: jīn tiān de yǔ bù rú zuó tiān dà lù shàng bù nán zǒu
items.en: Today's rain is not as heavy as yesterday's; the road isn't hard to walk.
items.why: 不如 is followed by the positive end of the scale (大), meaning 'less heavy'. 不如 + 小 would mean 'less light' and is wrong.

items.q: 你说秋天比春天舒服，可我觉得秋天___春天，我们这儿的秋天太干了。
items.zh: 你说秋天比春天舒服，可我觉得秋天不如春天，我们这儿的秋天太干了。
items.py: nǐ shuō qiū tiān bǐ chūn tiān shū fu kě wǒ jué de qiū tiān bù rú chūn tiān wǒ men zhè r de qiū tiān tài gàn le
items.en: You say autumn is more pleasant than spring, but I think autumn is not as good as spring; autumn here is too dry.
items.why: 不如 can end the sentence without an adjective: 'is not as good as'. 没有 needs an adjective, 不比 needs one too, and 比 says the opposite.

items.q: 我们这儿的冬天___北京一样冷，每年都下雪。
items.zh: 我们这儿的冬天跟北京一样冷，每年都下雪。
items.py: wǒ men zhè r de dōng tiān gēn běi jīng yī yàng lěng měi nián dōu xià xuě
items.en: Winter here is as cold as in Beijing; it snows every year.
items.why: Sameness is 跟 or 和 + B + 一样. 比 always marks a difference, and 没有 or 不如 would say 'less cold'.

items.q: 今天的气温跟昨天一样___，出门最好带件外套。
items.zh: 今天的气温跟昨天一样低，出门最好带件外套。
items.py: jīn tiān de qì wēn gēn zuó tiān yī yàng dī chū mén zuì hǎo dài jiàn wài tào
items.en: Today's temperature is as low as yesterday's, so you had better take a jacket.
items.why: The adjective after 一样 is bare: 一样低. 很 and 非常 cannot be added there, and 一点儿 is an amount that belongs to 比, not 一样.

items.q: 这个春天和去年的春天___，都很暖和。
items.zh: 这个春天和去年的春天一样，都很暖和。
items.py: zhè ge chūn tiān hé qù nián de chūn tiān yī yàng dōu hěn nuǎn huo
items.en: This spring is the same as last spring; both are warm.
items.why: 和 + B + 一样 says the two are alike, matching 都很暖和. 不一样 says they differ, which the second half contradicts.

items.q: 他跟他哥哥一点儿也___，性格完全不同。
items.zh: 他跟他哥哥一点儿也不一样，性格完全不同。
items.py: tā gēn tā gē ge yī diǎn r yě bù yī yàng xìng gé wán quán bù tóng
items.en: He is nothing like his older brother; their personalities are completely different.
items.why: 一点儿也 must go with a negative, so 不一样 is needed; 一样 would contradict 完全不同. 没有 and 不如 are not used after 跟 here.

items.q: 在我们五个人当中，小李唱歌唱得___好，别人都比不上他。
items.zh: 在我们五个人当中，小李唱歌唱得最好，别人都比不上他。
items.py: zài wǒ men wǔ gè rén dāng zhōng xiǎo lǐ chàng gē chàng de zuì hǎo bié rén dōu bǐ bù shàng tā
items.en: Among the five of us, Xiao Li sings best; nobody else can match him.
items.why: A group of several people points to 最 for the top one. 更 needs a single comparison, and 比较 means only 'fairly' and clashes with 比不上他.

items.q: 春天已经很舒服了，可是秋天___舒服，所以我最喜欢秋天。
items.zh: 春天已经很舒服了，可是秋天更舒服，所以我最喜欢秋天。
items.py: chūn tiān yǐ jīng hěn shū fu le kě shì qiū tiān gèng shū fu suǒ yǐ wǒ zuì xǐ huan qiū tiān
items.en: Spring is already very pleasant, but autumn is even more pleasant, so I like autumn best.
items.why: 更 means 'even more' than something just mentioned. 很, 比较 and 有点儿 do not carry that 'even' meaning after 可是.

items.q: 我们学校离地铁站___近，走路只要五分钟。
items.zh: 我们学校离地铁站比较近，走路只要五分钟。
items.py: wǒ men xué xiào lí dì tiě zhàn bǐ jiào jìn zǒu lù zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng
items.en: Our school is fairly close to the subway station; it takes only five minutes on foot.
items.why: 比较 before an adjective means 'fairly' and names no B. 比, 没有 and 不如 all need a second thing to compare with.

items.q: 一年四季里，我___喜欢秋天，其他三个季节都比不上。
items.zh: 一年四季里，我最喜欢秋天，其他三个季节都比不上。
items.py: yī nián sì jì lǐ wǒ zuì xǐ huan qiū tiān qí tā sān gè jì jié dōu bǐ bù shàng
items.en: Of the four seasons I like autumn best; the other three can't compare.
items.why: 最 picks the top from a group (the four seasons). 比较 is only 'rather', which does not fit 比不上, and 越 or 有点儿 do not belong before 喜欢.

items.q: 姐姐比我吃___多，可是她一点儿也不胖。
items.zh: 姐姐比我吃得多，可是她一点儿也不胖。
items.py: jiě jie bǐ wǒ chī de duō kě shì tā yī diǎn r yě bù pàng
