items.en: My older sister eats more than I do, yet she isn't fat at all.
items.why: Comparing how much someone does uses 吃得多; 得 links the verb to the adjective, even after 比我. 了, 着 and 过 do not link a verb to a degree.

items.q: 妹妹唱歌___得比我好听，大家都喜欢听她唱。
items.zh: 妹妹唱歌唱得比我好听，大家都喜欢听她唱。
items.py: mèi mei chàng gē chàng de bǐ wǒ hǎo tīng dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tīng tā chàng
items.en: My younger sister sings better than I do; everyone likes listening to her.
items.why: With an object (唱歌) the verb is repeated before 得: 唱歌唱得比我好听. Without the repeated 唱 the pattern is incomplete.

items.q: 这个周末的聚会，小张到___比我们都早，一个人在门口等了很久。
items.zh: 这个周末的聚会，小张到得比我们都早，一个人在门口等了很久。
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò de jù huì xiǎo zhāng dào de bǐ wǒ men dōu zǎo yí gè rén zài mén kǒu děng le hěn jiǔ
items.en: At this weekend's get-together Xiao Zhang arrived earlier than all of us and waited alone at the door for a long time.
items.why: How early someone arrives is a 得 complement: 到得比我们都早. 着, 了 and 过 cannot link a verb to its manner.

items.q: 他跑得___我快，所以第一个到终点的是他。
items.zh: 他跑得比我快，所以第一个到终点的是他。
items.py: tā pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài suǒ yǐ dì yí gè dào zhōng diǎn de shì tā
items.en: He runs faster than I do, so he was the first to reach the finish line.
items.why: 比 sits right after 得 when the comparison follows the verb: 跑得比我快. 没有 would say he is slower, and 跟 or 更 cannot stand in for 比.

items.q: 去年冬天的朋友聚会，小张唱歌唱___比我们每个人都好听，让大家都很惊讶。
items.zh: 去年冬天的朋友聚会，小张唱歌唱得比我们每个人都好听，让大家都很惊讶。
items.py: qù nián dōng tiān de péng you jù huì xiǎo zhāng chàng gē chàng de bǐ wǒ men měi gè rén dōu hǎo tīng ràng dà jiā dōu hěn jīng yà
items.en: At last winter's gathering of friends, Xiao Zhang sang better than any of us, which surprised everyone.
items.why: 唱歌唱得比我们每个人都好听 needs 得 to link the verb to the compared quality. 了, 着 and 过 mark aspect, not degree.

items.q: 天气越来越___了，该穿羽绒服了。
items.zh: 天气越来越冷了，该穿羽绒服了。
items.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le gāi chuān yǔ róng fú le
items.en: The weather is getting colder and colder; it is time to wear a down jacket.
items.why: 越来越 is followed by a bare adjective. 很 and 更 would double the degree, and 冷得 is an unfinished complement.

items.q: 最近我们见面的机会越来越少___，大家都太忙了。
items.zh: 最近我们见面的机会越来越少了，大家都太忙了。
items.py: zuì jìn wǒ men jiàn miàn de jī huì yuè lái yuè shǎo le dà jiā dōu tài máng le
items.en: We have fewer and fewer chances to meet lately; everyone is too busy.
items.why: 越来越 + adjective usually ends with 了 to mark the change. 着, 过 and 的 do not mark a change of state.

items.q: 他汉语说得越来越___，我们都为他高兴。
items.zh: 他汉语说得越来越好，我们都为他高兴。
items.py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de yuè lái yuè hǎo wǒ men dōu wèi tā gāo xìng
items.en: His Chinese is getting better and better, and we are all happy for him.
items.why: After 越来越 the adjective is bare: 好. 很好 and 更好 add a second degree word, which 越来越 already covers.

items.q: 他滑雪滑___越来越好了，今年冬天已经可以去高山了。
items.zh: 他滑雪滑得越来越好了，今年冬天已经可以去高山了。
items.py: tā huá xuě huá de yuè lái yuè hǎo le jīn nián dōng tiān yǐ jīng kě yǐ qù gāo shān le
items.en: He skis better and better; this winter he can already go to the high mountains.
items.why: With an action verb, 越来越 goes after 得 in the complement: 滑得越来越好. 着, 过 and 了 cannot connect the verb to that complement.

items.q: 夏天快到了，天气越来越___，晚上睡觉也越来越不舒服了。
items.zh: 夏天快到了，天气越来越热，晚上睡觉也越来越不舒服了。
items.py: xià tiān kuài dào le tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè wǎn shàng shuì jiào yě yuè lái yuè bù shū fu le
items.en: Summer is coming and the weather is getting hotter and hotter; sleeping at night is getting more and more uncomfortable.
items.why: 越来越 already supplies the degree, so the adjective stands bare. 很热, 非常热 and 太热 cannot follow it.

items.zh: 秋天比夏天凉快。
items.py: qiū tiān bǐ xià tiān liáng kuai
items.en: Autumn is cooler than summer.
items.why: The pattern is A 比 B + adjective: 比 夏天 comes before 凉快. English 'than' after the adjective is the trap.

items.zh: 明天比今天还冷。
items.py: míng tiān bǐ jīn tiān hái lěng
items.en: Tomorrow will be even colder than today.
items.why: 还 sits between 比 B and the adjective to mean 'even'. It cannot come before 比 or after 冷.

items.zh: 我朋友的家比我家更靠近公园。
items.py: wǒ péng you de jiā bǐ wǒ jiā gèng kào jìn gōng yuán
items.en: My friend's home is even closer to the park than my home.
items.why: 更 goes right before the verb phrase 靠近公园 in a 比 sentence, after 比 B. It cannot precede 比.

items.zh: 昨天比前天冷三度。
items.py: zuó tiān bǐ qián tiān lěng sān dù
items.en: Yesterday was three degrees colder than the day before yesterday.
items.why: The amount of difference comes after the adjective: 冷三度. Putting 三度 before 冷 is the English-order mistake.

items.zh: 上海的冬天比北京的冬天暖和一点儿。
items.py: shàng hǎi de dōng tiān bǐ běi jīng de dōng tiān nuǎn huo yī diǎn r
items.en: Winters in Shanghai are a bit warmer than winters in Beijing.
items.why: 一点儿 closes the sentence after the adjective. 有点儿 or 很 cannot take its place inside a 比 sentence.

items.zh: 我的朋友比我大三岁。
items.py: wǒ de péng you bǐ wǒ dà sān suì
items.en: My friend is three years older than me.
items.why: Ages use 大 or 小 followed by number + 岁: 大三岁. The number cannot be placed before 大.

items.zh: 北京的春天没有上海的暖和。
items.py: běi jīng de chūn tiān méi yǒu shàng hǎi de nuǎn huo
items.en: Spring in Beijing is not as warm as Shanghai's.
items.why: 'Not as ... as' is A 没有 B + adjective. Using 比 plus 不 before the adjective is wrong.

items.zh: 我跑得没有朋友快。
items.py: wǒ pǎo de méi yǒu péng you kuài
items.en: I don't run as fast as my friend.
items.why: In a 没有 comparison of actions the 得 complement keeps the adjective last: 跑得没有朋友快.

items.zh: 我的汉语没有他的那么好。
items.py: wǒ de hàn yǔ méi yǒu tā de nà me hǎo
items.en: My Chinese is not as good as his.
items.why: 那么 stands directly before the adjective after 没有 B. It cannot follow 好 or come before 没有.

items.zh: 夏天去爬山没有去游泳凉快。
items.py: xià tiān qù pá shān méi yǒu qù yóu yǒng liáng kuai
items.en: In summer, going hiking is not as cool as going swimming.
items.why: Both activities are verb phrases, and the adjective 凉快 closes the 没有 comparison. A 比 + 不 order is wrong.

items.zh: 今天不比昨天冷。
items.py: jīn tiān bù bǐ zuó tiān lěng
items.en: Today is no colder than yesterday.
items.why: 不 goes before 比, never before the adjective. It says 'not more than' and leaves room for equality.

items.zh: 我的汉语不如他的好。
items.py: wǒ de hàn yǔ bù rú tā de hǎo
items.en: My Chinese is not as good as his.
items.why: 不如 replaces 比, and the adjective that follows is a positive one (好).

items.zh: 在家看书不如出去走走有意思。
items.py: zài jiā kàn shū bù rú chū qù zǒu zǒu yǒu yì si
items.en: Reading at home is not as interesting as going out for a walk.
items.why: 不如 links two activities, and the positive adjective 有意思 comes last. 比 cannot be combined with it.

items.zh: 我的生日跟他的一样。
items.py: wǒ de shēng rì gēn tā de yī yàng
items.en: My birthday is the same as his.
items.why: A 跟 B 一样 puts 跟 B before 一样. 一样 cannot come before 跟.

items.zh: 今天的天气跟昨天一样好。
items.py: jīn tiān de tiān qì gēn zuó tiān yī yàng hǎo
items.en: Today's weather is as good as yesterday's.
items.why: The adjective follows 一样 directly: 一样好. It cannot be placed before 跟.

items.zh: 我和朋友一样喜欢下雪。
items.py: wǒ hé péng you yī yàng xǐ huan xià xuě
items.en: My friend and I both like snow equally.
items.why: 和 + B + 一样 works as an adverbial in front of the verb 喜欢. 比 never combines with 一样.

items.zh: 我最喜欢下雪的天气。
items.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan xià xuě de tiān qì
items.en: I like snowy weather best.
items.why: 最 stands directly before 喜欢. It cannot come after the verb or at the end.

items.zh: 他比我更喜欢秋天。
items.py: tā bǐ wǒ gèng xǐ huan qiū tiān
items.en: He likes autumn even more than I do.
items.why: In 比 + B + 更 + verb, 更 sits right before 喜欢. The 比我 phrase comes before 更.

items.zh: 他是我们班最高的。
items.py: tā shì wǒ men bān zuì gāo de
items.en: He is the tallest in our class.
items.why: The group 我们班 is placed before 最, not after the adjective as in English 'tallest in our class'.

items.zh: 妹妹比我游得好。
items.py: mèi mei bǐ wǒ yóu de hǎo
items.en: My younger sister swims better than I do.
items.why: Both 比我游得好 and 游得比我好 are fine; 得 must stay after the verb and 好 comes last.

items.zh: 今年春天比去年来得早。
items.py: jīn nián chūn tiān bǐ qù nián lái de zǎo
items.en: Spring has come earlier this year than last year.
items.why: 来得早 is a 得 complement, and 比去年 can come before the verb or right after 得.

items.zh: 天气越来越暖和了。
items.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo le
items.en: The weather is getting warmer and warmer.
items.why: 越来越 comes right before the adjective, and 了 closes the sentence to mark the change.

items.zh: 我越来越喜欢冬天了。
items.py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan dōng tiān le
items.en: I like winter more and more.
items.why: 越来越 sits before the verb of feeling 喜欢 and after the subject.

items.zh: 他说汉语说得越来越流利了。
items.py: tā shuō hàn yǔ shuō de yuè lái yuè liú lì le
items.en: He speaks Chinese more and more fluently.
items.why: With an action verb, 越来越 goes inside the 得 complement, right before the adjective.

items.src: 春天暖和，冬天不暖和。
items.src_py: chūn tiān nuǎn huo dōng tiān bù nuǎn huo
items.task: Say spring is warmer than winter, using 比.
items.zh: 春天比冬天暖和。
items.py: chūn tiān bǐ dōng tiān nuǎn huo
items.en: Spring is warmer than winter.
items.why: A 比 B + bare adjective compares the two seasons. No 很 is allowed before 暖和.

items.src: 今天很冷，昨天也很冷。
items.src_py: jīn tiān hěn lěng zuó tiān yě hěn lěng
items.task: Say today is even colder than yesterday, using 还.
items.zh: 今天比昨天还冷。
items.py: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān hái lěng
items.en: Today is even colder than yesterday.
items.why: 还 is allowed before the adjective in a 比 sentence and carries the 'even' meaning. 很 would be wrong there.

items.src: 姐姐二十五岁，我二十二岁。
items.src_py: jiě jie èr shí wǔ suì wǒ èr shí èr suì
items.task: Say my sister is three years older than me, using 比.
items.zh: 姐姐比我大三岁。
items.py: jiě jie bǐ wǒ dà sān suì
items.en: My older sister is three years older than me.
items.why: The age gap goes after 大: 大三岁. It cannot be placed before the adjective.

items.src: 今天十度，昨天十五度。
items.src_py: jīn tiān shí dù zuó tiān shí wǔ dù
items.task: Say today is five degrees colder than yesterday, using 比.
items.zh: 今天比昨天冷五度。
items.py: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng wǔ dù
items.en: Today is five degrees colder than yesterday.
items.why: The exact difference follows the adjective: 冷五度. 比昨天 comes before 冷.

items.src: 我朋友的车很贵，我的车不太贵。
items.src_py: wǒ péng you de chē hěn guì wǒ de chē bù tài guì
items.task: Say my friend's car is much more expensive than mine, using 得多.
items.zh: 我朋友的车比我的贵得多。
items.py: wǒ péng you de chē bǐ wǒ de guì de duō
items.en: My friend's car is much more expensive than mine.
items.why: 'Much more' is 得多 after the adjective. 很 before 贵 would break the 比 pattern.

items.src: 朋友比我高。
items.src_py: péng you bǐ wǒ gāo
items.task: Say I am not as tall as my friend, using 没有.
items.zh: 我没有朋友高。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu péng you gāo
items.en: I'm not as tall as my friend.
items.why: 'Not as tall as' is A 没有 B + adjective. 我比朋友不高 is the classic mistake.

items.src: 坐出租车比坐公共汽车快。
items.src_py: zuò chū zū chē bǐ zuò gōng gòng qì chē kuài
items.task: Say taking the bus is not as fast as taking a taxi, using 没有.
items.zh: 坐公共汽车没有坐出租车快。
items.py: zuò gōng gòng qì chē méi yǒu zuò chū zū chē kuài
items.en: Taking the bus is not as fast as taking a taxi.
items.why: Swapping the two things and using 没有 expresses 'not as fast as'. The adjective stays bare and last.

items.src: 夏天去山里比去海边凉快。
items.src_py: xià tiān qù shān lǐ bǐ qù hǎi biān liáng kuai
items.task: Say going to the seaside is not as cool as going to the mountains, using 不如.
items.zh: 夏天去海边不如去山里凉快。
items.py: xià tiān qù hǎi biān bù rú qù shān lǐ liáng kuai
items.en: In summer, going to the seaside is not as cool as going to the mountains.
items.why: 不如 replaces 比 and the positive adjective 凉快 follows. 比 cannot be combined with 不如.

items.src: 他说今天比昨天热，可我觉得差不多。
items.src_py: tā shuō jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān rè kě wǒ jué de chà bu duō
items.task: Say today is no hotter than yesterday, using 不比.
items.zh: 今天不比昨天热。
items.py: jīn tiān bù bǐ zuó tiān rè
items.en: Today is no hotter than yesterday.
items.why: 不比 means 'not more than', so equality is allowed. 不 goes before 比, not before 热.

items.src: 我的汉语没有他的汉语好。
items.src_py: wǒ de hàn yǔ méi yǒu tā de hàn yǔ hǎo
items.task: Say it with 不如 and no adjective.
items.zh: 我的汉语不如他的。
items.py: wǒ de hàn yǔ bù rú tā de
items.en: My Chinese is not as good as his.
items.why: 不如 can end a sentence without an adjective, meaning 'not as good as'. 没有 cannot do this.

items.src: 我今年二十岁，他今年也二十岁。
items.src_py: wǒ jīn nián èr shí suì tā jīn nián yě èr shí suì
items.task: Say we are the same age using 跟 ... 一样.
items.zh: 我跟他一样大。
items.py: wǒ gēn tā yī yàng dà
items.en: I'm the same age as he is.
items.why: Sameness is A 跟 B 一样 + adjective. 比 cannot be used for sameness.

items.src: 昨天很暖和，今天也很暖和。
items.src_py: zuó tiān hěn nuǎn huo jīn tiān yě hěn nuǎn huo
items.task: Say today is as warm as yesterday, using 跟 and 一样.
items.zh: 今天跟昨天一样暖和。
items.py: jīn tiān gēn zuó tiān yī yàng nuǎn huo
items.en: Today is as warm as yesterday.
items.why: The adjective follows 一样 directly, with no 很: 一样暖和.

items.src: 没有人比小李高。
items.src_py: méi yǒu rén bǐ xiǎo lǐ gāo
items.task: Say he is the tallest in the class, using 最.
items.zh: 小李是班里最高的。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ shì bān lǐ zuì gāo de
items.en: Xiao Li is the tallest in the class.
items.why: 最 marks the top of a group, and the group (班里) comes before 最.

items.src: 没有哪个季节比秋天舒服。
items.src_py: méi yǒu nǎ ge jì jié bǐ qiū tiān shū fu
items.task: Say autumn is the most comfortable season, using 最.
items.zh: 秋天是最舒服的季节。
items.py: qiū tiān shì zuì shū fu de jì jié
items.en: Autumn is the most comfortable season.
items.why: 最 sits directly before the adjective 舒服 inside the modifier of 季节.

items.src: 妹妹跳舞跳得很好，我跳得不太好。
items.src_py: mèi mei tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo wǒ tiào de bù tài hǎo
items.task: Say my younger sister dances better than I do, using 比.
items.zh: 妹妹跳舞跳得比我好。
items.py: mèi mei tiào wǔ tiào de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.en: My younger sister dances better than I do.
items.why: With an object (跳舞) the verb repeats: 跳舞跳得. 比我 comes right after 得 here and nothing precedes 好.

items.src: 他九点睡，我十二点睡。
items.src_py: tā jiǔ diǎn shuì wǒ shí èr diǎn shuì
items.task: Say he goes to bed earlier than I do, using 比.
items.zh: 他比我睡得早。
items.py: tā bǐ wǒ shuì de zǎo
items.en: He goes to bed earlier than I do.
items.why: 睡得早 keeps 得, and 比我 goes either before the verb or right after 得.

items.src: 我们这儿的冬天来得晚，北京的冬天来得早。
items.src_py: wǒ men zhè r de dōng tiān lái de wǎn běi jīng de dōng tiān lái de zǎo
items.task: Say winter comes earlier in Beijing than here, using 比.
items.zh: 北京的冬天比这儿来得早。
items.py: běi jīng de dōng tiān bǐ zhè r lái de zǎo
items.en: Winter comes earlier in Beijing than here.
items.why: 来得早 keeps 得, and 比这儿 sits before the verb or right after 得.

items.src: 我以前不太喜欢雪，现在很喜欢。
items.src_py: wǒ yǐ qián bù tài xǐ huan xuě xiàn zài hěn xǐ huan
items.task: Say I like snow more and more, using 越来越.
items.zh: 我越来越喜欢下雪了。
items.py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan xià xuě le
items.en: I like it more and more when it snows.
items.why: 越来越 goes directly before 喜欢. 很 or 更 cannot be added.

items.src: 我的朋友唱歌唱得一次比一次好。
items.src_py: wǒ de péng you chàng gē chàng de yī cì bǐ yī cì hǎo
items.task: Use 越来越 instead of 一次比一次.
items.zh: 我的朋友唱歌唱得越来越好了。
items.py: wǒ de péng you chàng gē chàng de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
items.en: My friend sings better and better.
items.why: With an action verb 越来越 goes after 得, right before the adjective.

items.s: 冬天比秋天非常冷。
items.s_py: dōng tiān bǐ qiū tiān fēi cháng lěng
items.zh: 冬天比秋天冷。
items.py: dōng tiān bǐ qiū tiān lěng
items.en: Winter is colder than autumn.
items.why: 非常 cannot stand before the adjective in a 比 sentence. The bare adjective 冷 is correct.

items.s: 明天比今天还冷，你多穿一点儿吧。
items.zh: 明天比今天还冷，你多穿一点儿吧。
items.py: míng tiān bǐ jīn tiān hái lěng nǐ duō chuān yī diǎn r ba
items.en: Tomorrow will be even colder than today; put on a bit more.
items.why: 还 is one of the two degree words (with 更) that may stand before the adjective in a 比 sentence, so this is correct.

items.s: 我的朋友比我高有点儿。
items.s_py: wǒ de péng you bǐ wǒ gāo yǒu diǎn r
items.zh: 我的朋友比我高一点儿。
items.py: wǒ de péng you bǐ wǒ gāo yī diǎn r
items.en: My friend is a bit taller than me.
items.why: 有点儿 goes before an adjective and does not fit a 比 sentence. A small difference is 一点儿 after the adjective.

items.s: 秋天的早晚比中午凉快得多。
items.zh: 秋天的早晚比中午凉快得多。
items.py: qiū tiān de zǎo wǎn bǐ zhōng wǔ liáng kuai de duō
items.en: In autumn, mornings and evenings are much cooler than noon.
items.why: 得多 after the adjective expresses 'much more' in a 比 sentence, so no 很 is needed before it. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 北京的春天比上海的春天不暖和。
items.s_py: běi jīng de chūn tiān bǐ shàng hǎi de chūn tiān bù nuǎn huo
items.zh: 北京的春天没有上海的春天暖和。
items.py: běi jīng de chūn tiān méi yǒu shàng hǎi de chūn tiān nuǎn huo
items.en: Spring in Beijing is not as warm as spring in Shanghai.
items.why: A 比 sentence is not negated before the adjective. 'Not as warm as' needs 没有.

items.s: 我们这儿的夏天没有南方那么热。
items.zh: 我们这儿的夏天没有南方那么热。
items.py: wǒ men zhè r de xià tiān méi yǒu nán fāng nà me rè
items.en: Summer here is not as hot as in the south.
items.why: 没有 B 那么 + adjective is the standard way to say 'not as ... as'. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 这家饭馆没有那家贵得多。
items.s_py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn méi yǒu nà jiā guì de duō
items.zh: 这家饭馆没有那家贵。
items.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn méi yǒu nà jiā guì
items.en: This restaurant is not as expensive as that one.
items.why: After 没有 B the adjective takes no amount like 得多. 'Not as expensive' is simply 没有那家贵.

items.s: 他的法语不如我差。
items.s_py: tā de fǎ yǔ bù rú wǒ chà
items.zh: 他的法语不如我好。
items.py: tā de fǎ yǔ bù rú wǒ hǎo
items.en: His French is not as good as mine.
items.why: 不如 must be followed by a positive quality. 差 makes it mean the opposite, so 好 is required.

items.s: 今天比昨天不如热。
items.s_py: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān bù rú rè
items.zh: 今天不如昨天热。
items.py: jīn tiān bù rú zuó tiān rè
items.en: Today is not as hot as yesterday.
items.why: 不如 replaces 比; the two cannot be combined. 'Not as hot as' is A 不如 B + adjective.

items.s: 这家店的衣服不比那家便宜，你不用特意来。
items.zh: 这家店的衣服不比那家便宜，你不用特意来。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de yī fu bù bǐ nà jiā pián yi nǐ bù yòng tè yì lái
items.en: Clothes in this shop are no cheaper than in that one, so you needn't make a special trip.
items.why: 不比 + adjective means 'not more than', here 'no cheaper than'. It is a correct sentence.

items.s: 今年夏天跟去年夏天一样很热。
items.s_py: jīn nián xià tiān gēn qù nián xià tiān yī yàng hěn rè
items.zh: 今年夏天跟去年夏天一样热。
items.py: jīn nián xià tiān gēn qù nián xià tiān yī yàng rè
items.en: This summer is as hot as last summer.
items.why: The adjective after 一样 stays bare. Adding 很 after 一样 is wrong.

items.s: 我的看法跟你的不一样，我喜欢冬天。
items.zh: 我的看法跟你的不一样，我喜欢冬天。
items.py: wǒ de kàn fǎ gēn nǐ de bù yī yàng wǒ xǐ huan dōng tiān
items.en: My view is different from yours; I like winter.
items.why: 不一样 normally stands alone without an adjective, so the sentence is correct.

items.s: 小王比我一样喜欢爬山。
items.s_py: xiǎo wáng bǐ wǒ yī yàng xǐ huan pá shān
items.zh: 小王跟我一样喜欢爬山。
items.py: xiǎo wáng gēn wǒ yī yàng xǐ huan pá shān
items.en: Xiao Wang likes hiking just as much as I do.
items.why: 比 means a difference and cannot combine with 一样. Sameness uses 跟 or 和.

items.s: 今天比较比昨天暖和。
items.s_py: jīn tiān bǐ jiào bǐ zuó tiān nuǎn huo
items.zh: 今天比昨天暖和。
items.py: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān nuǎn huo
items.en: Today is warmer than yesterday.
items.why: 比较 is the adverb 'fairly' and cannot be placed inside a 比 sentence. 比 alone marks the comparison.

items.s: 春天的时候，这里的天气比较冷，晚上要穿外套。
items.zh: 春天的时候，这里的天气比较冷，晚上要穿外套。
items.py: chūn tiān de shí hou zhè lǐ de tiān qì bǐ jiào lěng wǎn shàng yào chuān wài tào
items.en: In spring the weather here is fairly cold, and you need a jacket at night.
items.why: 比较 + adjective means 'fairly' and needs no second thing to compare. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 冬天是最我喜欢的季节。
items.s_py: dōng tiān shì zuì wǒ xǐ huan de jì jié
items.zh: 冬天是我最喜欢的季节。
items.py: dōng tiān shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de jì jié
items.en: Winter is my favourite season.
items.why: 最 goes directly before 喜欢, after the subject 我. Placing it before 我 is wrong.

items.s: 她唱歌得比我好。
items.s_py: tā chàng gē de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.zh: 她唱歌唱得比我好。
items.py: tā chàng gē chàng de bǐ wǒ hǎo
items.en: She sings better than I do.
items.why: With an object the verb must be repeated before 得. 唱歌得 skips the second 唱 and is wrong.

items.s: 他跑得比我快得多。
items.zh: 他跑得比我快得多。
items.py: tā pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài de duō
items.en: He runs much faster than I do.
items.why: 比我 after 得 is fine, and the amount 得多 closes the sentence after the adjective. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 他越来越汉语说得好了。
items.s_py: tā yuè lái yuè hàn yǔ shuō de hǎo le
items.zh: 他汉语说得越来越好了。
items.py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
items.en: His Chinese is getting better and better.
items.why: With an action verb, 越来越 goes inside the 得 complement before the adjective, not before the object.

items.s: 我们见面的机会越来越少了。
items.zh: 我们见面的机会越来越少了。
items.py: wǒ men jiàn miàn de jī huì yuè lái yuè shǎo le
items.en: We have fewer and fewer chances to meet.
items.why: 越来越 can go before the adjective 少 even when the subject is a longer noun phrase. The sentence is correct.
